description:
Now starring as Melissa Schemmenti in ABC’s #1 show, the Emmy-nominated “Abbott Elementary”, Actress, Creator/Producer/Writer Lisa Ann Walter’s career spans television, film and the stage. She is known for stand-out roles in feature films such as “The Parent Trap”, “Bruce Almighty”, “Shall We Dance”, “War of the Worlds” and “Killers”.

Walter is also the co-creator and star of several network sitcoms and unscripted series. Lisa Ann is the proud Creator, Executive Producer and Judge on the highest rated first year NBC/UNI cable series, DANCE YOUR ASS OFF, with over a dozen foreign formats She co-created, produced and directed the original series GONZO GIRLS. and has both scripted and unscripted series currently in development. She has enjoyed guesting on numerous hit shows; THE ODD COUPLE, THE EXES, NIP/TUCK, CURB YOUR ENTHUSIASM, GREY’S ANATOMY, 9-1-1, GLOW.

Lisa Ann spent 10 years headlining clubs all over the country. Her first televised comedy set was as a featured professional standup act on “It’s Showtime at the Apollo” where she turned a skeptical crowd into a cheering one and led to scores of Television spots and she was recently featured on “Gotham Comedy Live”. Walter has hosted dozens of A-List events including “Talk of the Town”, “The Icon Awards” honoring Sidney Poitier, “The Hollywood Bag Ladies luncheon for Lupus” & more. Her comedic memoire/essays on self-loathing, THE BEST THING ABOUT MY ASS IS THAT IT’S BEHIND ME, was a life-changing book published by Harper One and was #13 on the NY Times & Amazon Bestseller Lists.

But Walter is most proud of being a working mom of 4 with “One foot on the Red Carpet…The other at Costco” and that her stomach is still reasonably flat after being the clown car they all came out of.

description:
Known throughout the comedy industry as the “The Beautiful Beast,” Tacarra Williams is setting stages ablaze nationwide. From the moment she emerges with her bright, endearing smile audiences erupt with excitement and are held captive by her every word, doubling over in side-splitting laughter. Using her hard-won wisdom learned from the streets of NYC, her experience as a young mother, and her most recent endeavor as a Life Skills coach to inmates in the largest jail system in America, Tacarra dares to be the voice for every woman — fearlessly sharing her thoughts and experiences, refusing to bow down to prejudiced opinions. Her attitude towards female empowerment has earned her respect and love from men and women alike.

Tacarra’s talent and wit are undeniable. She’s opened for renowned comedians like Tony Rock, Deray Davis, and Bill Bellamy. Recently featured on NBC’s Bring the Funny, she’s been described as “fearless” and “unapologetically honest.” Tacarra has graced major stages in New York and Hollywood, including Carolines, Broadway Comedy Club, Apollo Theatre, Hollywood Improv, The Comedy Store, The Laugh Factory, and Russell Simmons’ All Def Digital. Her 30-minute comedy special, produced by Kevin Hart, has been featured on Comedy Central and last year, she made her hosting debut on the CW’s  Totally Funny Kids.

Please note, there is a 2 item per person minimum in the showroom. This can be any combination of food items or beverages. This does NOT include items bought in the basement at the Bier Baron Tavern.

All General Admission seating is first come first serve, therefore we cannot guarantee seating together. Groups need to be particularly aware of this. We recommend arriving at least 30 minutes to an hour prior to show time for better seat selection.

Doors close 30 minutes after showtime.

Tickets are available at the door UNLESS tickets have sold out.

Guests must be 18+for entry. Those under the age of 21 will be given wristbands to wear.

description:
Funnyman Lavell Crawford is quickly climbing the comedic ranks and becoming one of the hottest stars in the biz today. His one-hour stand-up special, "Can A Brother Get Some Love?" premiered on Comedy Central in 2011. Filmed in his hometown of St. Louis, MO, it was released on DVD later the same year. In addition, he filmed an episode of "Workaholics" for Comedy Central and he was cast in a recurring role on AMC's Emmy Award-winning "Breaking Bad." If that's not enough, he has also appeared as a regular panelist on E! Entertainment's "Chelsea Lately" and on "Lopez Tonight," performing in various comedy sketches on the show. Given his numerous television appearances and his popular touring act, audiences are becoming increasingly familiar with Lavell's giant-sized talent.

Lavell gained national exposure on NBC's hit reality series "Last Comic Standing." Not only did NBC take notice, promptly signing Lavell to a holding deal with the network, but Comedy Central offering him his own half-hour stand-up special, "Comedy Central Presents Lavell Crawford," which aired in 2009. Lavell's stand-out work includes appearances on "Shaquille O'Neal Presents: All Star Comedy Jam" which premiered on Showtime, "Russell Simmons' Def Comedy Jam" on HBO, "Showtime at the Apollo," "Martin Lawrence Presents 1st Amendment," "Comics Unleashed with Byron Allen," "Steve Harvey's Big Time," Comedy Central's "Premium Blend," "Motown Live" and BET's "Comic View."

Lavell has appeared in the films "Baby's Mama Drama," "Beverlyhood" and "Ghetto South Problems," and on the televised series "The Jamie Foxx Show." On stage, he played Ben in the hit play "Men Cry in the Dark," based on the Michael Baisden best seller. Lavell played the scene-stealing character of "Bobby" in the critically-acclaimed "Friends and Lovers," a stage production based on the novel by Eric Jerome Dickey. ABOUT THE SHOW

Logie and Melbourne International Comedy Festival award-winning comedian Aaron Chen from Netflix special “Funny Garden” and one of the foremost guys in “Fisk,” “Make That Movie” and “The Dink” is coming to tour the world with his new show, “Technology." It deals with technology.

ABOUT THE COMEDIAN

Born and raised in Sydney, Australia, Aaron has quickly climbed the ranks of the international comedy scene. He was just named one of Deadline’s 15 Comedians Ready to Break Out In 2025 [deadline.com] and Vulture’s 2024 Comedian’s You Should Know [vulture.com].

Aaron made his mark on Australian comedy with his debut solo show at the Melbourne Comedy Festival in 2017 and since then has toured internationally  in front of sold-out crowds. On the acting front, Aaron has had feature roles in Ronny Chieng: International Student (ABC), Orange is the New Brown (Seven Network), and the international hit comedy series FISK (Netflix).

As a comedian he also appears on Australia’s #1 panel show, Have You Been Paying Attention (Network 10) and Guy Montgomery’s Spelling Bee (Three). description:

Kirsten has headlined clubs and colleges nationwide and opened for Tim Meadows, Judy Gold, Mark Gagnon, and Laurie Kilmartin. PLEASE NOTE:

Kirsten is a comedian living with Cystic Fibrosis. While we understand that other individuals with Cystic Fibrosis may want to enjoy her comedy live, the CF Foundation recommends only one person with Cystic Fibrosis per indoor space. We kindly ask that if you are an individual living with Cystic Fibrosis, you please respect these boundaries for everyone’s safety. Many adults with CF may feel more comfortable taking risks while on modulators, such as Trikafta or similar life-changing medications, however Kirsten has a rare CF mutation and does not qualify for these new treatments, leaving her still very vulnerable.

If you have CF and still intend on coming to a show knowing these risks, while we cannot require anyone to disclose their medical history, we respectfully ask that you email [contact removed] to give a heads-up that you will be in attendance. We will make sure to seat you at least six feet from the stage. Thank you for your understanding while we prioritize the health and safety of all CFers.

description:
Comedian. Actor. Musician. Advocate. Entrepreneur. Five-time Grammy and Emmy nominee. When hasn’t Margaret Cho ’s strong voice been part of our consciousness? It feels like she has always been here, like a friend you can always count on, lighting the path for other women, other members of underrepresented groups, other performers, to follow.

Margaret staunchly supports the causes that are important to her: anti-racism, anti-bullying, gay rights, all while fulfilling her successful creative side with a legendary stand up career that has yielded 10-plus comedy tours. Her recent television & movie roles include “Erin” in HULU’s smash Fire Island, guest starring on the Ryan Murphy hit Doctor Odyssey , The Flight Attendant (HBO Max), Hacks (HBO Max) and two Netflix is a Joke comedy specials including Outstanding: A Comedy Revolution . Margaret’s latest film, All That We Love , premiered at the Tribeca Film Festival, earning Margaret rave reviews, and she is set to star as “Wasp,” one of the “Gray Sisters” in Season 2 of Disney’s Percy Jackson and the Olympians as well as in Gregg Araki’s movie thriller I Want Your Sex .

Margaret, who Vogue magazine named one of the 9 best female comedians of all time, alongside Joan Rivers, Gilda Radner and Wanda Sykes, appreciates where she finds herself right now. “I think comedians in general, we get better as we get older, and we kind of get more observant, and more astute in those observations."

Thankfully, Margaret has more stories to tell, and her production company, Animal Family Productions , has multiple scripted shows in development for 2024 and beyond.

PLEASE NOTE: This show is not for the faint of heart. Expect graphic content, explicit sexual humor, strong language, and boundary-pushing material. Recommended for audiences who aren’t easily offended.

Her first televised comedy set was as a featured professional standup act on “It’s Showtime at the Apollo” where she turned a skeptical crowd into a cheering one and led to scores of Television spots and she was recently featured on “Gotham Comedy Live”. Walter has hosted dozens of A-List events including “Talk of the Town”, “The Icon Awards” honoring Sidney Poitier, “The Hollywood Bag Ladies luncheon for Lupus” & more. Her comedic memoire/essays on self-loathing, THE BEST THING ABOUT MY ASS IS THAT IT’S BEHIND ME, was a life-changing book published by Harper One and was #13 on the NY Times & Amazon Bestseller Lists.

But Walter is most proud of being a working mom of 4 with “One foot on the Red Carpet…The other at Costco” and that her stomach is still reasonably flat after being the clown car they all came out of.

Walter has hosted dozens of A-List events including “Talk of the Town”, “The Icon Awards” honoring Sidney Poitier, “The Hollywood Bag Ladies luncheon for Lupus” & more. description:
Brendan is a rising stand-up comedian known for his charismatic stage presence, quick punchlines, and honest, self-aware storytelling. Brendan started comedy in Philadelphia but now splits his time performing regularly in both Philly and New York. Brendan draws his material from his everyday life, family chaos, and questionable decision-making to craft jokes that feel personal and universally relatable. His approachable, fast-paced, and authentic comedy style helps him standout in any lineup.Brendan regularly features and headlines all over the Northeast. He is a regular at New York Comedy Club and Helium and Punchline in Philadelphia. description:
Open Mic Night - this is where it begins.

Wiseguys Open Mic is a weekly showcase of Utah's best up-and-coming performers. Each show is a hilarious mix of professionals working on new material, amateur comedians working on their chops, and first-timers being thrown in the mix.

Wiseguys Open Mic is held every Wednesday at Wiseguys Downtown SLC at the Gateway.

How do I sign up?

Please email  [contact removed]  and request a spot on the next open mic. You may submit one email request for  yourself only  up to one week before the next scheduled open mic. You may not request a spot several weeks in advance of the night you'd like to perform. Anyone interested in performing on Open Mic night must send in an email request; there are no longer sign-ups the night of the show. If you are selected to do a spot, we will respond to your email. It is up to you to check your email.

If you are a comic visiting from out of town, please email us and we will try to make room for you. All performers must be aged 21 or older.

How will I know if I'm on the show?

We will respond via email to everyone who will be on the open mic no later than 6pm the Tuesday before open mic. If you are selected, feel free to invite friends and family to come watch and support your performance. Admission is $5 for audience members and free for performers. It is your responsibility to check your email to see if you've been selected.

What if I'm not chosen to be on the show?

We do our best to give everyone an opportunity to perform but we can't always squeeze everyone on to the show because of high demand. If you are not selected to perform, keep sending in email requests. Be persistent and patient (and nice) and we will make sure you have an opportunity to take the stage. If you’re not selected, please come to the show and support anyway. Your support of the other open mic performers is noticed and appreciated and won’t hurt your chances to be selected for a future open mic.

description:
Born and raised in Madera, California, Phil Medina turned a lifelong talent for making people laugh into a nationally touring stand-up comedy career after taking a leap of faith in 2008. His rapid rise earned him performances at iconic venues including The Ice House, The Laugh Factory, and The Hollywood Improv, paving the way for a career that has seen him headline comedy clubs and theaters across the country, win multiple stand-up comedy competitions, and become the national voice of Hungry Howie's Pizza commercials. Beyond stand-up, Phil has appeared in feature films on Amazon Prime and is currently the voice of a character on a Disney+ series, further showcasing his versatility as a performer. In 2024, he was selected to perform at the prestigious Netflix Is A Joke Festival, cementing his place among comedy's rising stars. Known for his commanding stage presence, razor-sharp wit, and effortless ability to connect with audiences, Phil Medina continues to establish himself as one of the most exciting and sought-after comedic voices in entertainment.

description:
Comedian. Actor. Musician. Advocate. Entrepreneur. Five-time Grammy and Emmy nominee. When hasn’t Margaret Cho ’s strong voice been part of our consciousness? It feels like she has always been here, like a friend you can always count on, lighting the path for other women, other members of underrepresented groups, other performers, to follow.

Margaret staunchly supports the causes that are important to her: anti-racism, anti-bullying, gay rights, all while fulfilling her successful creative side with a legendary stand up career that has yielded 10-plus comedy tours. Her recent television & movie roles include “Erin” in HULU’s smash Fire Island, guest starring on the Ryan Murphy hit Doctor Odyssey , The Flight Attendant (HBO Max), Hacks (HBO Max) and two Netflix is a Joke comedy specials including Outstanding: A Comedy Revolution . Margaret’s latest film, All That We Love , premiered at the Tribeca Film Festival, earning Margaret rave reviews, and she is set to star as “Wasp,” one of the “Gray Sisters” in Season 2 of Disney’s Percy Jackson and the Olympians as well as in Gregg Araki’s movie thriller I Want Your Sex .

Margaret, who Vogue magazine named one of the 9 best female comedians of all time, alongside Joan Rivers, Gilda Radner and Wanda Sykes, appreciates where she finds herself right now. “I think comedians in general, we get better as we get older, and we kind of get more observant, and more astute in those observations."

Thankfully, Margaret has more stories to tell, and her production company, Animal Family Productions , has multiple scripted shows in development for 2024 and beyond.

PLEASE NOTE: This show is not for the faint of heart. Expect graphic content, explicit sexual humor, strong language, and boundary-pushing material. Recommended for audiences who aren’t easily offended.

description:
Brendan is a rising stand-up comedian known for his charismatic stage presence, quick punchlines, and honest, self-aware storytelling. Brendan started comedy in Philadelphia but now splits his time performing regularly in both Philly and New York. Brendan draws his material from his everyday life, family chaos, and questionable decision-making to craft jokes that feel personal and universally relatable. His approachable, fast-paced, and authentic comedy style helps him standout in any lineup.Brendan regularly features and headlines all over the Northeast. He is a regular at New York Comedy Club and Helium and Punchline in Philadelphia. He was a finalist in New York Comedy Club’s stand up competition and the 1st runner up in Helium Comedy Club’s Philly’s Phunniest competition in 2024. Brendan’s stand up has been featured on TruTV and Sirius XM, and he has performed at festivals such as the Red Clay Comedy Festival, Rogue Island Comedy Festival, and has showcased for Netflix is a Joke and JFL independently.

description:
Originally from Norway, Daniel Simonsen is a Norwegian/Chilean stand-up comedian. He can be seen in Stavros Halkias’s feature, Let’s Start A Cult on Hulu and Joe Pera's new Adult Swim series, My Two Cars. Daniel regularly opens for Louis CK and has also opened for Stavros Halkias, Bert Kreischer, Ari Shaffir, and performed at Dave Chappelle’s YS Firehouse. He made his US late-night debut on Late Night with Seth Meyers. He has since appeared on CC Stand-Up Featuring, The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, Stavvy’s World, and recurred on Comedy Central’s This Week at the Comedy Cellar. Daniel’s Colbert performance was reviewed by Vulture. He was named NY's Funniest at the NYCF and performs at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival regularly. He won UK’s So You Think You’re Funny award and went on to win the Best Newcomer award after that.

While in the UK, Daniel had a recurring role on Vic and Bob’s BBC sitcom, House of Fools and ITV’s Timewasters. He created and wrote his own digital series for ALL4 called, Daniel directed by Andrew Gaynord (People of the Earth, Netflix Presents: The Characters, Detroiters, Stath Lets Flats, etc.) that starred him, Natasia Demetriou, and Brett Goldstein. He also appeared on Russell Howard’s Good News. He is a Comedy Cellar regular and tours nationwide and internationally.

description: One show. Two dads. Thirteen years of questionable life choices. In 2013, Tom and Haydn made a pact: they would have children as long-form character research for a 60-minute comedy show about the collapse of civilisation. Now, thirteen years of sleep deprivation and school runs later, they’ve arrived at the Camden Fringe to collect their 10% box office split. Tom wants a sophisticated, barbed autopsy of the geopolitical landscape—think The Rest is Politics with more panic. Haydn wants to shield himself from the end of days mainly with wigs, maybe some hats. What follows is a high-stakes clash between intentionality and anarchy. A show for anyone who fears for their children’s future, even if they were sired for comedy purposes, or anyone who suspects the apocalypse might just be one long Sunday afternoon with nothing to watch on Netflix. Come for the promise of light entertainment. Stay for the safety of being underground.
title: Fathering in the Age of the Apocalypse

description: Join Queen Elizabeth II in God Save the Queen! — a no-holds-barred, warts-and-all one-woman comedy spectacular where Her Maj finally spills the royal tea. From awkward palace dinners and eyebrow-raising prime ministers to scandalous royal rivalries and the secrets behind the crown, nothing is off-limits as Lizzy tells her side of the story with razor-sharp wit, biting charm, and a gin firmly in hand. Expect scandal, sass, and revelations you definitely won’t hear at the palace gates — all delivered with camp flair and regal confidence. The Queen is fabulously portrayed by Lady Red Velvet, British drag artist living in Barcelona and a powerhouse international entertainer. An award-winning LGBTQ+ activist, Lady Red Velvet is also the creator of the cult hit Dragatha Christie, blending drag, theatre, and murder mystery into unforgettable stage experiences. Comedian. Actor. Musician. Advocate. Entrepreneur. Five-time Grammy and Emmy nominee. When hasn’t Margaret Cho ’s strong voice been part of our consciousness? It feels like she has always been here, like a friend you can always count on, lighting the path for other women, other members of underrepresented groups, other performers, to follow.

Margaret staunchly supports the causes that are important to her: anti-racism, anti-bullying, gay rights, all while fulfilling her successful creative side with a legendary stand up career that has yielded 10-plus comedy tours. Her recent television & movie roles include “Erin” in HULU’s smash Fire Island, guest starring on the Ryan Murphy hit Doctor Odyssey , The Flight Attendant (HBO Max), Hacks (HBO Max) and two Netflix is a Joke comedy specials including Outstanding: A Comedy Revolution . Margaret’s latest film, All That We Love , premiered at the Tribeca Film Festival, earning Margaret rave reviews, and she is set to star as “Wasp,” one of the “Gray Sisters” in Season 2 of Disney’s Percy Jackson and the Olympians as well as in Gregg Araki’s movie thriller I Want Your Sex .

Margaret, who Vogue magazine named one of the 9 best female comedians of all time, alongside Joan Rivers, Gilda Radner and Wanda Sykes, appreciates where she finds herself right now. “I think comedians in general, we get better as we get older, and we kind of get more observant, and more astute in those observations."

Thankfully, Margaret has more stories to tell, and her production company, Animal Family Productions , has multiple scripted shows in development for 2024 and beyond.

description: Comedian Shuler King was born Frank Williams III in Sumter, South Carolina. He knew at an early age that he was destined to be an entertainer especially since he was the kid known for cracking jokes. King grew up in a traditional 2-parent household in the Bible Belt of the South, where Faith, Hard Work and Education were the foundations of what his parents imparted on him and his two siblings. Comedy is his passion, but he has taken a rather unusual path to get to where he is thus far. He graduated from the University of South Carolina with a B.A. in Media Arts where he joined The Mighty Illustrious Zeta Zeta Chapter of Omega Psi Phi Fraternity, Incorporated. In 2013 he graduated from Gupton Jones Mortuary College with a degree in Mortuary Science. When he isn’t on the road performing at comedy clubs and special events across the country, King works as a licensed funeral director and embalmer in Georgia and South Carolina at his family’s funeral business in South Carolina. He wants to keep his family’s business and legacy alive. He’s probably the only Comedian/Funeral Director on the comedy circuit. King has opened for some of the most notable and talented comedians and comediennes in the industry. He credits his parents strict yet loving upbringing, his harsh surroundings growing up and the state of the country today with giving him his comedic style, which he describes as RAW. King says “Comedy isn’t about being happy all the time. Comedy is just as much about pain that people endure. When you hear 20,000 people in an arena laugh at a joke it’s because they all can relate to experiencing that same pain”. His comedy career began while he was a Freshman in college, after he took the stage for the very first time at the NCO Club on a military base and the rest is history. King is one of the most energetic rising comedians in the business. Although the comedy business can be very tough and filled with ups and downs, King credits his unwavering Faith in God as the…
title: Special Event: Shuler King

description:
Using his experiences growing up in Newark, Bill Bellamy started doing stand-up while he was a student at Rutgers University. Bellamy quickly discovered how much he enjoyed making people laugh, and began honing his skills at small comedy clubs around the country and was soon making waves in the New York clubs like The Improv, The Comic Strip, and at The Comedy Store in Los Angeles.

In less than two years of launching his stand-up career, Bellamy earned a spot on HBO’s DEF COMEDY JAM where he notoriously coined the phrase “Booty Call.” The now famous late-night rendez-vous moniker became the name for his first comedy special for Showtime; “Booty Call” and it was instantly one of the network’s top-rated specials.

Bellamy became a staple on MTV as one of the first “VJs” on the network. He hosted several of their programming blocks, including MTV JAMS and MTV BEACH HOUSE, while interviewing everyone from the late Kurt Cobain to Janet Jackson. In 1996, Bill landed his own series, “The Billy Bellamy Show.”

Bill starred in the syndicated show MR. BOX OFFICE alongside along side Jon Lovitz, Tim Meadows, and Viveca J. Fox. Prior to MR. BOX OFFICE Bellamy has appeared on recurring episodes of Tyler Perry’s MEET THE BROWNS/TBS and has guest-starred on ABC’s CASTLE, USA’s ROYAL PAINS, USA’s WHITE COLLAR & TNT’s MURDER IN THE FIRST. Previously, Bill hosted four seasons of the TV One comedy competition show WHO’S GOT JOKES? and two seasons of NBC’s Emmy Nominated LAST COMIC STANDING.

Bellamy also continued to star on the big screen in addition to garnering coveted guest roles in several prominent television series. In the feature world, Bellamy starred in LOVE JONES, HOW TO BE A PLAYER, LOVE STINKS, THE BROTHERS, and ANY GIVEN SUNDAY. At the same time, showcasing his mutli-hyphenate talents, Bellamy continued to hone his comedy and stand-up prowess. He debuted his second comedy special, CRAZY SEXY DIRTY in May 2012, it was one of the highest rated comedy specials of their…

description:
Comedian and actor Drew Lynch captured the hearts of America with his Golden Buzzer performance on Season 10 of America’s Got Talent, where he finished in second place. After sustaining a traumatic brain injury at age 20, Drew turned to stand-up comedy as a way to rebuild his confidence and reclaim his quality of life, developing a signature self-deprecating style that quickly resonated with audiences.

Since then, Drew has amassed millions of followers across social media and continues to tour worldwide to sold-out crowds. He released multiple comedy specials, including And These Are Jokes and Short King in 2023, as well as his most recent hour-long special, The Stuttering Comedian. He also expanded his impact through a widely viewed TEDx Talk “Why curiosity gets you farther than ambition” where he spoke candidly about stuttering, resilience, and embracing imperfections, further inspiring audiences around the world. Today, Drew continues to connect with fans through his stand-up, digital content, and live performances.
title: Drew Lynch

description:
Ahamed Weinberg is a comedian, writer, actor, and director from Philadelphia. He served as Story Editor on Ramy Youssef's A24/Amazon animated series, #1  Happy Family USA,  and Netflix's upcoming series  GOLF.  He created, directed, and starred in the new Stapleview digital series  45 Years Later  and did the same for Comedy Central's  Ahamed's Ramadan Diary . He created and co-directed the digital series  Please Understand Me,  executive produced by Sarah Silverman, and his short film  Lovebirds  premiered on Amazon Prime. As an actor, he recently played himself in the Emmy award-winning series  Hacks.  Before that, he   recurred on Crave's  Late Bloomer , and HBO's  Insecure .

Ahamed has performed on  Late Night with Seth Meyers  and  The Late Show with Stephen Colbert , and  was featured in  TimeOut LA's Comics to Watch  and  Vulture's 20 Comics to Watch . His online presence is substantial, with millions of views across stand-up clips, Don't Tell Comedy, and Comedy Central sets. He frequently opens for Shane Gillis and Hasan Minhaj in sold-out stadiums across America. Ahamed has also appeared on  The Eric Andre Show , and the 2025 revival of TBS'  The Joe Schmo Show . He currently resides in Brooklyn.
title: Ahamed Weinberg from Hacks!

description:
Comedian. Actor. Musician. Advocate. Entrepreneur. Five-time Grammy and Emmy nominee. When hasn’t Margaret Cho ’s strong voice been part of our consciousness? It feels like she has always been here, like a friend you can always count on, lighting the path for other women, other members of underrepresented groups, other performers, to follow.

Margaret staunchly supports the causes that are important to her: anti-racism, anti-bullying, gay rights, all while fulfilling her successful creative side with a legendary stand up career that has yielded 10-plus comedy tours. Her recent television & movie roles include “Erin” in HULU’s smash Fire Island, guest starring on the Ryan Murphy hit Doctor Odyssey , The Flight Attendant (HBO Max), Hacks (HBO Max) and two Netflix is a Joke comedy specials including Outstanding: A Comedy Revolution . Margaret’s latest film, All That We Love , premiered at the Tribeca Film Festival, earning Margaret rave reviews, and she is set to star as “Wasp,” one of the “Gray Sisters” in Season 2 of Disney’s Percy Jackson and the Olympians as well as in Gregg Araki’s movie thriller I Want Your Sex .

Margaret, who Vogue magazine named one of the 9 best female comedians of all time, alongside Joan Rivers, Gilda Radner and Wanda Sykes, appreciates where she finds herself right now. “I think comedians in general, we get better as we get older, and we kind of get more observant, and more astute in those observations."

Thankfully, Margaret has more stories to tell, and her production company, Animal Family Productions , has multiple scripted shows in development for 2024 and beyond.

PLEASE NOTE: This show is not for the faint of heart. Expect graphic content, explicit sexual humor, strong language, and boundary-pushing material. Recommended for audiences who aren’t easily offended.

description: Comedian Shuler King was born Frank Williams III in Sumter, South Carolina. He knew at an early age that he was destined to be an entertainer especially since he was the kid known for cracking jokes. King grew up in a traditional 2-parent household in the Bible Belt of the South, where Faith, Hard Work and Education were the foundations of what his parents imparted on him and his two siblings. Comedy is his passion, but he has taken a rather unusual path to get to where he is thus far. He graduated from the University of South Carolina with a B.A. in Media Arts where he joined The Mighty Illustrious Zeta Zeta Chapter of Omega Psi Phi Fraternity, Incorporated. In 2013 he graduated from Gupton Jones Mortuary College with a degree in Mortuary Science. When he isn’t on the road performing at comedy clubs and special events across the country, King works as a licensed funeral director and embalmer in Georgia and South Carolina at his family’s funeral business in South Carolina. He wants to keep his family’s business and legacy alive. He’s probably the only Comedian/Funeral Director on the comedy circuit. King has opened for some of the most notable and talented comedians and comediennes in the industry. He credits his parents strict yet loving upbringing, his harsh surroundings growing up and the state of the country today with giving him his comedic style, which he describes as RAW. King says “Comedy isn’t about being happy all the time. Comedy is just as much about pain that people endure. When you hear 20,000 people in an arena laugh at a joke it’s because they all can relate to experiencing that same pain”. His comedy career began while he was a Freshman in college, after he took the stage for the very first time at the NCO Club on a military base and the rest is history. King is one of the most energetic rising comedians in the business. Although the comedy business can be very tough and filled with ups and downs, King credits his unwavering Faith in God as the…
title: Special Event: Shuler King

description:
Using his experiences growing up in Newark, Bill Bellamy started doing stand-up while he was a student at Rutgers University. Bellamy quickly discovered how much he enjoyed making people laugh, and began honing his skills at small comedy clubs around the country and was soon making waves in the New York clubs like The Improv, The Comic Strip, and at The Comedy Store in Los Angeles.

In less than two years of launching his stand-up career, Bellamy earned a spot on HBO’s DEF COMEDY JAM where he notoriously coined the phrase “Booty Call.” The now famous late-night rendez-vous moniker became the name for his first comedy special for Showtime; “Booty Call” and it was instantly one of the network’s top-rated specials.

Bellamy became a staple on MTV as one of the first “VJs” on the network. He hosted several of their programming blocks, including MTV JAMS and MTV BEACH HOUSE, while interviewing everyone from the late Kurt Cobain to Janet Jackson. In 1996, Bill landed his own series, “The Billy Bellamy Show.”

Bill starred in the syndicated show MR. BOX OFFICE alongside along side Jon Lovitz, Tim Meadows, and Viveca J. Fox. Prior to MR. BOX OFFICE Bellamy has appeared on recurring episodes of Tyler Perry’s MEET THE BROWNS/TBS and has guest-starred on ABC’s CASTLE, USA’s ROYAL PAINS, USA’s WHITE COLLAR & TNT’s MURDER IN THE FIRST. Previously, Bill hosted four seasons of the TV One comedy competition show WHO’S GOT JOKES? and two seasons of NBC’s Emmy Nominated LAST COMIC STANDING.

Bellamy also continued to star on the big screen in addition to garnering coveted guest roles in several prominent television series. In the feature world, Bellamy starred in LOVE JONES, HOW TO BE A PLAYER, LOVE STINKS, THE BROTHERS, and ANY GIVEN SUNDAY. At the same time, showcasing his mutli-hyphenate talents, Bellamy continued to hone his comedy and stand-up prowess. He debuted his second comedy special, CRAZY SEXY DIRTY in May 2012, it was one of the highest rated comedy specials of their…
title: Special Event: Bill Bellamy

description:
John Moyer brings 25 years of award-winning comedy and improvisational showmanship to the art of stage hypnosis. Known for his approachable and genuine persona, John’s passion lies in creating unforgettable entertainment experiences that keep audiences laughing, amazed, and thoroughly engaged.

From showrooms in Las Vegas to Royal Caribbean Cruise Line stages around the world, John delivers dynamic, out-of-the-box performances that leave audiences laughing, amazed, and coming back for more.

This stage hypnosis show reimagines a centuries-old art form. Set to modern music and infused with pop culture, it’s fun, fast-paced, and packed with energy, making it a hit with audiences of all ages. Beyond the laughter and amazement, John delivers something truly unique: every on-stage participant leaves with a lasting gift, empowered to harness the power of their mind for positive change.
title: Comedy Hypnosis w John Moyer

description:
Seth Tippetts has been entertaining audiences for over a decade. His debut comedy special “Tall. Dark. Gigante.” released in 2019 by Dry Bar Comedy has totaled over 10 million views. He’s opened for dozens of nationally touring comedians and local legends alike. He has received numerous accolades in comedy competitions such as the prestigious "participation award" in the Rocky Mountain Laugh Off.

Seth is a U of U basketball alumnus. During his time on the team he was banned from doing comedy because his jokes made shooting percentages go down. He was so hilarious they lost the Mountain West tournament handily. After immediately being cut from the team for incompetence, he realized that his only remaining talent lay in comedy.

Seth’s comedy style mostly features personal stories, passionate ramblings, and $6 words. You’ll enjoy laughing along with Seth’s clever wit, but make sure you pay attention, or you might miss a joke amongst his fast-talk and booming voice.
title: Seth Tippetts

Originally from Fort Lauderdale, FL, I received his Bachelor’s in Business Management from West Virginia State University (2019). I then moved to Atlanta, with a career in hospitality, where I managed hotels, during the day and performed at the comedy clubs at night. I’ve been able to cultivate my craft and perform along side comedians like Capone, Donnell Rawlings, and Josh Blue. Featured at premiere clubs like the stardome, helium, and Atlanta Comedy Theater.

TV programs like The Daily Wire: Judged by Matt Walsh, 85 South: I got 5 on it and a short film: Kill Yourself (YouTube)

Considered as natural crowd-connector, I thrive both on stage and as a host, keeping rooms engaged with quick improvisation and an infectious personality. Whether I’m breaking down relationships, life’s curveballs, or the absurdity of everyday hustle, my comedy feels authentic, unpredictable, and unapologetically funny.

Along with his cohorts in the comedy troupe, The Grawlix, he created, wrote, and starred on the TV show, Those Who Can't, which aired for three seasons. The Grawlix also host the longest running indie comedy show in the country in their home town of Denver, and have a popular podcast called, "Advice Fight.”

description:
A regular on the Sydney comedy circuit,  Jenny Tian  exploded onto our #fyp during the pandemic notching up millions of likes and amassing a collective online audience of 1M+. Her debut solo show Picture This sold out to audiences up and down the east coast of Australia and was released as a YouTube special where it has nearly a million views. Her second hour Chinese Australian: A Tale of Internet Fame sold out across Australia and took her to her first ever runs at the Edinburgh Fringe and West End's Boulevard Theatre, also selling out both. Off the back of her stand up success, Jenny has secured spots on the lineup for the 2024, 2025, and 2026 Melbourne International Comedy Festival Galas and as a cast member in season 2 of Taskmaster AU, the latter earning her a Logie nomination for Best New Talent.

After a stint in London, Jenny is now living in New York and just completed her first US tour of her most recent hour, the aptly titled Jenny’s Travels, and has been named by Deadline as a stand-up to keep an eye on in 2026. Recently announced as a recipient of Screen Aus and YouTube’s funding initiative, Skip Ahead, Jenny is in post-production on Dupermarket, a web series that she's starring in and co-writing with Patrick Golamco. Her third special, Supreme Mother, launched on Veeps in May 2026.

description:
Originally from Norway, Daniel Simonsen is a Norwegian/Chilean stand-up comedian. He can be seen in Stavros Halkias’s feature, Let’s Start A Cult on Hulu and Joe Pera's new Adult Swim series, My Two Cars. Daniel regularly opens for Louis CK and has also opened for Stavros Halkias, Bert Kreischer, Ari Shaffir, and performed at Dave Chappelle’s YS Firehouse. He made his US late-night debut on Late Night with Seth Meyers. He has since appeared on CC Stand-Up Featuring, The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, Stavvy’s World, and recurred on Comedy Central’s This Week at the Comedy Cellar. Daniel’s Colbert performance was reviewed by Vulture. He was named NY's Funniest at the NYCF and performs at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival regularly. He won UK’s So You Think You’re Funny award and went on to win the Best Newcomer award after that.

While in the UK, Daniel had a recurring role on Vic and Bob’s BBC sitcom, House of Fools and ITV’s Timewasters. He created and wrote his own digital series for ALL4 called, Daniel directed by Andrew Gaynord (People of the Earth, Netflix Presents: The Characters, Detroiters, Stath Lets Flats, etc.) that starred him, Natasia Demetriou, and Brett Goldstein. He also appeared on Russell Howard’s Good News. He is a Comedy Cellar regular and tours nationwide and internationally.

description:
Comedian and actor Drew Lynch captured the hearts of America with his Golden Buzzer performance on Season 10 of America’s Got Talent, where he finished in second place. After sustaining a traumatic brain injury at age 20, Drew turned to stand-up comedy as a way to rebuild his confidence and reclaim his quality of life, developing a signature self-deprecating style that quickly resonated with audiences.

Since then, Drew has amassed millions of followers across social media and continues to tour worldwide to sold-out crowds. He released multiple comedy specials, including And These Are Jokes and Short King in 2023, as well as his most recent hour-long special, The Stuttering Comedian. He also expanded his impact through a widely viewed TEDx Talk “Why curiosity gets you farther than ambition” where he spoke candidly about stuttering, resilience, and embracing imperfections, further inspiring audiences around the world. Today, Drew continues to connect with fans through his stand-up, digital content, and live performances.
title: Drew Lynch

description: A preview the best poetry and spoken word shows at the 2026 PBH Free Fringe. Fast talking, hard-hitting, side-splitting poetry - a bit of everything for long time lovers of words and newcomers alike - a helping hand for those looking to fill up their Fringe schedules with spoken word!

description: Joke of the Fringe winner, Mark Simmons (Mock the Week) returns to Edinburgh with his new one-liners, midway through his sold-out national tour. A show for people that like jokes.

description: The cult panel show returns! Bring in an item, pop it in the box and host Friz Frizzle will invent games on the spot for their comedian guests. This year's confirmed contestants include stars of Dropout, Taskmaster and award winners. Lineups announced the day before on the [handle removed] Instagram. Box!
show_series_name: FRIZ FRIZZLE’S WHAT’S IN THE BOX?
title: FRIZ FRIZZLE’S WHAT’S IN THE BOX?

description: Start your day at the fringe with Tim. His new stand-up show is about finding life's golden ticket. With high-energy jokes and stories about fame, family and travel with a hapless hippy. The ISH Edinburgh Comedy Awards 2025 Best Show nominee. Best Comedy at Shaftesbury Fringe 2025. 'Conjures up something both playful and killer' One4Review.co.uk
title: TIM BIGLOWE: PLONKA

description: The harbinger of rock'n'drole returns to the Fringe with his 10th 'must-see show'. Jam-packed with guitar-wielding wordplay and silliness, this is musical comedy turned up to 11! 'Clever, unpredictable puns... and the guitar is top notch' (BroadwayBaby.com).
show_series_name: ROBIN BOOT’S ROCKOMEDY: PUN TO THE HILLS
title: ROBIN BOOT’S ROCKOMEDY: PUN TO THE HILLS

description: Help to help yourself with various gurus and self-proclaimed expert on everything Elise Harris. This show will change your life! Possibly. Well, it might. Or not. What do I know? Meh. Positive thinking!
title: ELISE HARRIS: BETTER BE BEST

description: Hollywood hellraiser and Free Fringe veteran Sir Dickie Benson returns, joining forces with award-winning burlesque star and producer Scarlett Whispers, to bring you a riotous, eclectic mix of burlesque, magic, music and comedy featuring some of the best acts from across the Fringe. Live, loud and interactive - with a different line-up every time!
title: SIR DICKIE BENSON’S MIDDAY MANIA

description: George has been treading the boards of acting for some time now but how exactly did he get there and what else has he done during his life? Join George as he takes you through his life from school to interviews then to starring in Panto and how he lives day to day meeting and interacting with different types of people.
title: GEORGE COPPEN: WON’T BE LONG!

description: A Comedy Tapas of up to 7 different comedians per day. Each giving a sample of their Edinburgh Comedy show.
title: A COMEDY TAPAS

description: Steve McLean hosts comedians reading funny poetry and telling lovely stories. The hit show of 2025 is back. Curated acts will deliver rhymes and laughs before your Fringe day becomes all sequins and glitter
show_series_name: ADORABLE COMEDIANS PERFORM POETRY AND TELL STORIES WITH STEVE MCLEAN
title: ADORABLE COMEDIANS PERFORM POETRY AND TELL STORIES WITH STEVE MCLEAN
venue_name: Pizza Geeks Easter Road – Back room

description: If Greggs don't sponsor this woman, they are really missing a trick' ★★★★ (Scotsman). Find out how this stereotypical northern, pansexual human makes it through the day. Kebabs mainly. Pegasus Musical Comedian of the Year 2025. 'An unmissable talent' (WeeReview)
show_series_name: ANGLE OF THE NORTH: NATALIE DURKIN
title: ANGLE OF THE NORTH: NATALIE DURKIN

description: Mary's life is falling apart, she's just found out that her boyfriend (THAT SHE LIVES WITH AND FINANCIALLY SUPPORTS) has cheated on her right before her 30th birthday. Faced with the consequences of her terrible taste in men, she has to reflect on what "having it all" really means. A show about love, revenge and what to do when you hit rock bottom
show_series_name: MARY O’CONNELL: BREADWINNER – WORK IN PROGRESS
title: MARY O’CONNELL: BREADWINNER – WORK IN PROGRESS

description: The audience is dead. God is about to pass judgment. In the waiting room, a defence lawyer has just under an hour to build your case. Every show is different because every audience is different. Some souls are much harder to save than others. The Skinny★★★★★ Chortle★★★★★ The Guardian ★★★★ The Times★★★★ The List★★★★ The Scotsman★★★★
title: LUKE MCQUEEN: THE WAITING ROOM (W.I.P)

BBC New Comedy Award Nominee. Half of double act Crizards (★★★★ Guardian). As seen/heard on BBC One, Radio 4. "A special talent" Rolling Stone ★★★★★ Fringe Review ★★★★ The Skinny ★★★★ Broadway Baby
title: EDDY HARE: AFTER SHAVE (WIP)

description: High fidelity stand-up comedy. Alastair shares jokes and stories from a near decade working behind the counter of an independent record shop. A show that waxes lyrical about crate digging, needle dropping and arguing with children about Limp Bizkit. ★★★★★ The Sphinx. ★★★★ One4Review. ★★★★ North West End. ★★★★ The Tab. ★★★★ Lancaster Guardian.
title: ALASTAIR CLARK: ON THE RECORD

description: Dr Silcox believed that gold trading would land him in the company of successful entrepreneurs but a series of events broke all his dreams. Thank god he found silent meditation to keep himself sane. Now he wants to spread peace and advise his audience what is life and how to fulfil it without materials, through meditation.
show_series_name: MARK SILCOX: GOLD TRADING SUCKS, I LOST EVERYTHING.
title: MARK SILCOX: GOLD TRADING SUCKS, I LOST EVERYTHING.

description: Join us every Saturday for an open comedy-writing workshop.
title: Open Writing Workshop

description: A fast-paced hour of stand-up featuring a rotating lineup of razor sharp, brilliant comedians—plus special guests. From punchy one-liners to wild storytelling, expect big laughs, unexpected moments, and a showcase of comic talent.
title: WHOLE LOTTA COMEDY

description: "If you're Lebanese, why's your name Karl?" The question doesn't bother Karl. He loves it when border control shows a personal interest. His answer is a grin, the same smile that's won him marital feuds and the attention of pickpockets. Karl comes to the Fringe for the first time this summer: no frills, no AI, just jokes and his Big Dumb Smile.
title: KARL DAGHER: BIG DUMB SMILE

description: In this new one hour of political satire the Argentinean, a lifelong football fan and human rights advocate, dives into the absurdity of FIFA awarding "peace prizes", to talking about Messi, Maradona, and the history of the sport. If you love the game... or if you hate the game... this show is for you!
show_series_name: ADRIAN MINKOWICZ: THE HAND OF GOD
title: ADRIAN MINKOWICZ: THE HAND OF GOD

description: Katie Garcia has one question. She's been asking it for years. Maybe she'll get the answer in this one-week WIP. Tour support for Michelle DeSwarte, Joanne McNally, Red Richardson & Jonathan Van Ness. As seen on Comedy Central. ★★★★- The Skinny. ★★★★- Funny Women
show_series_name: DO YOU THINK HE LIKES ME? (WORK IN PROGRESS)
title: DO YOU THINK HE LIKES ME? (WORK IN PROGRESS)

description: Wondering when all your work will pay off? Waiting for your lucky break? This show is for you. Expect songs and strong feelings. Chortle and Leicester Comedy Festival Award nominee ★★★★★ "Surprisingly powerful - will leave you in tears of laughter" Broadway World ★★★★★ "Hugely talented" Three Weeks
title: ALEXANDER BENNETT: ALL IT TAKES

description: Join Salma, British-Pakistani stand-up, for stories of spats with her formidable Muslim mother (who thinks she's holier than Christ) & her husband's raucous Irish-Catholic family (who definitely aren't). A fearless, fresh new voice in comedy. WestEndWomenComedy Finalist: "Salma's persona lulls an audience in and blindsides them with killer punchlines"
show_series_name: SALMA HABIB LYONS: WORK IN PROGRESS
title: SALMA HABIB LYONS: WORK IN PROGRESS

description: Classic magic enters the 21st century. Award-winning magician Callum McClure blends technology and timeless sleight of hand to create unforgettable moments and unexpected twists. The impossible, made modern
show_series_name: CALLUM MCCLURE: WON’T GET FOOLED AGAIN
title: CALLUM MCCLURE: WON’T GET FOOLED AGAIN

description: British comedian Dan Willis brings his critically acclaimed show to the Edinburgh Fringe. He moved to Australia 15 years ago. Now he's got a bag of jokes, experiences and hangovers to share. 'Unpretentious, informal, belly laughs a minute stand-up' ★★★★ (ThreeWeeks). 'Sixty minutes of side-splitting laughter' ★★★★★ (Plains Producer).
title: AUSTRALIA: A COMEDIANS GUIDE

description: Everybody knows the world's a bit broken, but the people who are certain they know what to do about it are, not to be rude, f-ing nuts. This is a show about trying to work out what we're actually supposed to do when we might just be idiots with our hearts in the right place. "Funny as hell makes me feel great about the hope I have." Lara Ricote.
show_series_name: MARC SALMON: WE’VE GOT TO DO SOMETHING (WIP)
title: MARC SALMON: WE’VE GOT TO DO SOMETHING (WIP)

description: The ultra-privileged master of making the seemingly unrelatable, relatable. As seen on Netflix The Circle , Comedy Central and viral videos living in The Tower of London. "this unexpected tour de force warrants a 21-gun salute" ★★★★★ The Daily Telegraph "Clever, passionate and soulful" ★★★★★ The New European
title: TOM HOUGHON

description: A handpicked selection of the best comedians at Fringe 2026 in the heart of Leith every Saturday and Sunday, for absolutely free!!See the very best in Fringe Comedy at the Brass Monkey on Leith Walk. Just by the Tram, and great for Leithers. Some big

title: Leith Laughs - Pick of the Fringe

description: A stand up comedy show about the absurdities of India, the US and the UK where Prateek has lived. The absurdities get historical, political, and to outright denial when it's least expected. Prateek is an Indian comic who is quickly making his name in the UK comedy circuit and can regularly be seen performing at top comedy clubs across the country.
title: PRATEEK KOHLI: DENIAL

description: When you're on the fringes of society and suicide, which do you choose? Comedian Kimmie Dee's dark comedy examines whether she's suicidal or just mining material for Fringe.
show_series_name: ON THE FRINGE OF SUICIDAL TENDENCIES
title: ON THE FRINGE OF SUICIDAL TENDENCIES

description: The award winning hit of last year's fringe returns due to incredible demand following a UK and New Zealand tour. 'A rather lovely piece of storytelling...witty, well constructed...an elegant and funny hour...exceptional' ★★★★ (Chortle.co.uk). 'Funny, and charming' (Ben Shepherd, ITV).
title: DANNY WARD: THE HOLIDAY

description: When H G Wells wrote The Shape of Things to Come, did he imagine the shape we have become? Well this out-of-shape comedian wants to know. Can we come together and explore the stars? Or do we just order another pizza? Award winning comic Alan Francis asks is there any room left for humanity in a world of technological madness!
title: ALAN FRANCIS  HARD WIRED

description: The title describes the show. Does what it says on the tin. The oldest newcomer at the Fringe will make you laugh. Not important or self-important
show_series_name: 55 MINUTES OF ADEQUATELY AMUSING JOKES AND STORIES FROM AN IRISHMAN WHO RECENTLY TURNED 67
title: 55 MINUTES OF ADEQUATELY AMUSING JOKES AND STORIES FROM AN IRISHMAN WHO RECENTLY TURNED 67

description: A comedy magic show like no other. Very funny, interactive, cheeky - but suitable for the whole family. He's performed for sky tv, the chief of police, ministry of defense and more. Voted best of the night at the ICC Birmingham, Winner of Freaky got talent comedy club, Nominated one of the Best entertainers 2005, 2006 & 2008 for John Fowler holidays.

title: THE BEST COMEDY MAGIC SHOW YOU’LL SEE IN THE NEXT 45 MINUTES (PROBABLY)

description: Is this a show about my mom going to jail? Or is it a show about motherhood? Or is this actually a show about how I feel about money? Come find out How to Be Happy All The Time. ★★★★★ Young(ish) Perspective ★★★★ Wee Review ★★★★★ Broadway Baby "Incredible joke writer" - Mae Martin

title: ZOE BROWNSTONE: HOW TO BE HAPPY ALL THE TIME

description: Sansha is falling behind in life and has written songs to prove it's everyone else's fault. Expect a rap from the perspective of a slug, a five minute Cockney Victorian musical, family feuds, Andrew Tate fans, and one genuinely lovely song. It's definitely not her personality. To be fair to her. "Sansha is my one to watch"-Freshonthenet.com

title: SANSHA: TO BE FAIR TO ME

And for some reason he's doing a free show. Free. Like, properly free! Doesn't seem right, does it? If you don't like it, you can have your money back.

description: Top Northern craic from Middlesbrough's finest idiots, Eppie Brilliant and Gareth Harrison. One with a guitar, one with a microphone. Both deeply unqualified. Songs, stand-stand up and a right good knees up!
title: Eppie Brilliant and Gareth Harrison: Alright Now

description: Someone has died. The cause? Suspicious. The suspects? Everyone they ever knew. A Curious Demise is a fully improvised show that begins at the end. Each show opens on the untimely demise of a brand-new character, dreamed up on the spot from audience suggestions. Was it the best friend with the suspicious smile? The coworker passed over for promotion one too many times? The ex who never quite let go? Part murder mystery, part character study, part beautifully chaotic time machine — A Curious Demise is an improv show that proves that every life, no matter how ordinary, ends with one very good question. How did they meet their demise?
title: A Curious Demise

description: The shortest story ever told (1hr). His dog is for sale. And that's not all. Ed Mulvey (Best Newcomer Nominee Edinburgh Ish Awards 2025) delivers a double measure of grim hilarity with a chaser of unworn dog. A cry against help from the Elon Musk of emotions. "First-rate joke writer" - The Scotsman; "An original thinker... bleakly funny" - Chortle
show_series_name: ED MULVEY: FOR SALE – DEAD DOG NEVER WORN
title: ED MULVEY: FOR SALE – DEAD DOG NEVER WORN

description: Join Alex Mason (Komedia Best New Comedian Finalist 2024, Chortle Student Comedy Finalist 2022), following two sold-out Edinburgh Fringe runs, for a smart, silly stand-up show analysing her fan-fiction hyper-fixation.'Thoroughly engaging... enjoyably loose' (Chortle.co.uk).

description: Slicing through capitalism, rockets, trad wives and her online-shopping shame. Sharp, relatable satire for women fed up with billionaires, burnout and BS. Wildcard Amused Moose New Comedian 2020, and Semi-finalist British Comedian of the Year 2021. Review of previous show DINK 2024 One4Review 4★★★★ 'Finding the funny wherever she goes'

description: Comedian Shuler King was born Frank Williams III in Sumter, South Carolina. He knew at an early age that he was destined to be an entertainer especially since he was the kid known for cracking jokes. King grew up in a traditional 2-parent household in the Bible Belt of the South, where Faith, Hard Work and Education were the foundations of what his parents imparted on him and his two siblings. Comedy is his passion, but he has taken a rather unusual path to get to where he is thus far. He graduated from the University of South Carolina with a B.A. in Media Arts where he joined The Mighty Illustrious Zeta Zeta Chapter of Omega Psi Phi Fraternity, Incorporated. In 2013 he graduated from Gupton Jones Mortuary College with a degree in Mortuary Science. When he isn’t on the road performing at comedy clubs and special events across the country, King works as a licensed funeral director and embalmer in Georgia and South Carolina at his family’s funeral business in South Carolina. He wants to keep his family’s business and legacy alive. He’s probably the only Comedian/Funeral Director on the comedy circuit. King has opened for some of the most notable and talented comedians and comediennes in the industry. He credits his parents strict yet loving upbringing, his harsh surroundings growing up and the state of the country today with giving him his comedic style, which he describes as RAW. King says “Comedy isn’t about being happy all the time. Comedy is just as much about pain that people endure. When you hear 20,000 people in an arena laugh at a joke it’s because they all can relate to experiencing that same pain”. His comedy career began while he was a Freshman in college, after he took the stage for the very first time at the NCO Club on a military base and the rest is history. King is one of the most energetic rising comedians in the business. Although the comedy business can be very tough and filled with ups and downs, King credits his unwavering Faith in God as the…

description:
K-Striggss is a high-energy stand-up comedian known for his sharp wit, real-life storytelling, and fearless honesty. Blending clever observations with raw, relatable experiences, he turns everyday situations into laugh-out-loud moments that hit home with audiences from all walks of life.

Originally from Fort Lauderdale, FL, I received his Bachelor’s in Business Management from West Virginia State University (2019). I then moved to Atlanta, with a career in hospitality, where I managed hotels, during the day and performed at the comedy clubs at night. I’ve been able to cultivate my craft and perform along side comedians like Capone, Donnell Rawlings, and Josh Blue. Featured at premiere clubs like the stardome, helium, and Atlanta Comedy Theater.

description:
Known to you as the students who were always the loud kids in the back of the classroom, the Unteachables are a group of stand-up comedians who just happened to fall backwards into educating America’s youth. Their material extends far beyond just the chaos that exists in their classroom. They offer authentic comedy to everyone, regardless of if they've worked in education, need a break from reality, or just love to laugh. The Unteachables have been featured on NBC, The Breakfast Club, and The New York Post.

Stephen Taylor

Originally a Louisiana native, Stephen moved to Kansas City to escape his traditional southern roots. Combining his unique perspective with some interesting stories and some sweet southern charm, Stephen headlines and features at your favorite clubs, bars, and colleges across the country, as well as his own classroom. He has been featured on The Breakfast Club, The New York Post, and at San Francisco Sketchfest. His debut special 'The Bottom Half' charted to #1 on iTunes and can be seen on Amazon and Apple TV.

Lou Pharis

Raised in the non-famous parts of Louisiana, Lou Pharis never thought he’d be anything more than an NFL caliber offensive lineman. After failing to go pro and then losing out on American Ninja Warrior, Lou turned his talents to the public education system. A particularly rough day at school made Lou sign up for his first open mic when he realized there’s a teacher shortage, so he couldn’t be fired for doing comedy. Lou’s stand-up has since found massive success, garnering over 100 million views on social media. He now headlines clubs across the United States, has been seen on NBC and Bored Teachers, and has performed at dozens of comedy festivals across the country.

Miss Redacted

Miss Redacted is a teacher, soon to be trophy wife, and rapidly rising comedian. After spending years in the classroom she now uses stand-up to process what therapy and a salary schedule couldn't. Despite the efforts of her girl boss mother, she is…
title: Special Event: The Unteachables

description:
Comedian. Actor. Musician. Advocate. Entrepreneur. Five-time Grammy and Emmy nominee. When hasn’t Margaret Cho ’s strong voice been part of our consciousness? It feels like she has always been here, like a friend you can always count on, lighting the path for other women, other members of underrepresented groups, other performers, to follow.

Margaret staunchly supports the causes that are important to her: anti-racism, anti-bullying, gay rights, all while fulfilling her successful creative side with a legendary stand up career that has yielded 10-plus comedy tours. Her recent television & movie roles include “Erin” in HULU’s smash Fire Island, guest starring on the Ryan Murphy hit Doctor Odyssey , The Flight Attendant (HBO Max), Hacks (HBO Max) and two Netflix is a Joke comedy specials including Outstanding: A Comedy Revolution . Margaret’s latest film, All That We Love , premiered at the Tribeca Film Festival, earning Margaret rave reviews, and she is set to star as “Wasp,” one of the “Gray Sisters” in Season 2 of Disney’s Percy Jackson and the Olympians as well as in Gregg Araki’s movie thriller I Want Your Sex .

Margaret, who Vogue magazine named one of the 9 best female comedians of all time, alongside Joan Rivers, Gilda Radner and Wanda Sykes, appreciates where she finds herself right now. “I think comedians in general, we get better as we get older, and we kind of get more observant, and more astute in those observations."

Thankfully, Margaret has more stories to tell, and her production company, Animal Family Productions , has multiple scripted shows in development for 2024 and beyond.

PLEASE NOTE: This show is not for the faint of heart. Expect graphic content, explicit sexual humor, strong language, and boundary-pushing material. Recommended for audiences who aren’t easily offended.

Using his experiences growing up in Newark, Bill Bellamy started doing stand-up while he was a student at Rutgers University. Bellamy quickly discovered how much he enjoyed making people laugh, and began honing his skills at small comedy clubs around the country and was soon making waves in the New York clubs like The Improv, The Comic Strip, and at The Comedy Store in Los Angeles.

In less than two years of launching his stand-up career, Bellamy earned a spot on HBO’s DEF COMEDY JAM where he notoriously coined the phrase “Booty Call.” The now famous late-night rendez-vous moniker became the name for his first comedy special for Showtime; “Booty Call” and it was instantly one of the network’s top-rated specials.

Bellamy became a staple on MTV as one of the first “VJs” on the network. He hosted several of their programming blocks, including MTV JAMS and MTV BEACH HOUSE, while interviewing everyone from the late Kurt Cobain to Janet Jackson. In 1996, Bill landed his own series, “The Billy Bellamy Show.”

Bill starred in the syndicated show MR. BOX OFFICE alongside along side Jon Lovitz, Tim Meadows, and Viveca J. Fox. Prior to MR. BOX OFFICE Bellamy has appeared on recurring episodes of Tyler Perry’s MEET THE BROWNS/TBS and has guest-starred on ABC’s CASTLE, USA’s ROYAL PAINS, USA’s WHITE COLLAR & TNT’s MURDER IN THE FIRST. Previously, Bill hosted four seasons of the TV One comedy competition show WHO’S GOT JOKES? and two seasons of NBC’s Emmy Nominated LAST COMIC STANDING.

Bellamy also continued to star on the big screen in addition to garnering coveted guest roles in several prominent television series. In the feature world, Bellamy starred in LOVE JONES, HOW TO BE A PLAYER, LOVE STINKS, THE BROTHERS, and ANY GIVEN SUNDAY. At the same time, showcasing his mutli-hyphenate talents, Bellamy continued to hone his comedy and stand-up prowess. He debuted his second comedy special, CRAZY SEXY DIRTY in May 2012, it was one of the highest rated comedy specials of their…

A regular on the Sydney comedy circuit,  Jenny Tian  exploded onto our #fyp during the pandemic notching up millions of likes and amassing a collective online audience of 1M+. Her debut solo show Picture This sold out to audiences up and down the east coast of Australia and was released as a YouTube special where it has nearly a million views. Her second hour Chinese Australian: A Tale of Internet Fame sold out across Australia and took her to her first ever runs at the Edinburgh Fringe and West End's Boulevard Theatre, also selling out both. Off the back of her stand up success, Jenny has secured spots on the lineup for the 2024, 2025, and 2026 Melbourne International Comedy Festival Galas and as a cast member in season 2 of Taskmaster AU, the latter earning her a Logie nomination for Best New Talent.

Her third special, Supreme Mother, launched on Veeps in May 2026.

description: Comedian Shuler King was born Frank Williams III in Sumter, South Carolina. He knew at an early age that he was destined to be an entertainer especially since he was the kid known for cracking jokes. King grew up in a traditional 2-parent household in the Bible Belt of the South, where Faith, Hard Work and Education were the foundations of what his parents imparted on him and his two siblings. Comedy is his passion, but he has taken a rather unusual path to get to where he is thus far. He graduated from the University of South Carolina with a B.A. in Media Arts where he joined The Mighty Illustrious Zeta Zeta Chapter of Omega Psi Phi Fraternity, Incorporated. In 2013 he graduated from Gupton Jones Mortuary College with a degree in Mortuary Science. When he isn’t on the road performing at comedy clubs and special events across the country, King works as a licensed funeral director and embalmer in Georgia and South Carolina at his family’s funeral business in South Carolina. He wants to keep his family’s business and legacy alive. He’s probably the only Comedian/Funeral Director on the comedy circuit. King has opened for some of the most notable and talented comedians and comediennes in the industry. He credits his parents strict yet loving upbringing, his harsh surroundings growing up and the state of the country today with giving him his comedic style, which he describes as RAW. King says “Comedy isn’t about being happy all the time. Comedy is just as much about pain that people endure. When you hear 20,000 people in an arena laugh at a joke it’s because they all can relate to experiencing that same pain”. His comedy career began while he was a Freshman in college, after he took the stage for the very first time at the NCO Club on a military base and the rest is history. King is one of the most energetic rising comedians in the business. Although the comedy business can be very tough and filled with ups and downs, King credits his unwavering Faith in God as the…

Comedian and actor Drew Lynch captured the hearts of America with his Golden Buzzer performance on Season 10 of America’s Got Talent, where he finished in second place. After sustaining a traumatic brain injury at age 20, Drew turned to stand-up comedy as a way to rebuild his confidence and reclaim his quality of life, developing a signature self-deprecating style that quickly resonated with audiences.

Since then, Drew has amassed millions of followers across social media and continues to tour worldwide to sold-out crowds. He released multiple comedy specials, including And These Are Jokes and Short King in 2023, as well as his most recent hour-long special, The Stuttering Comedian. He also expanded his impact through a widely viewed TEDx Talk “Why curiosity gets you farther than ambition” where he spoke candidly about stuttering, resilience, and embracing imperfections, further inspiring audiences around the world. Today, Drew continues to connect with fans through his stand-up, digital content, and live performances.

Comedian. Actor. Musician. Advocate. Entrepreneur. Five-time Grammy and Emmy nominee. When hasn’t Margaret Cho ’s strong voice been part of our consciousness? It feels like she has always been here, like a friend you can always count on, lighting the path for other women, other members of underrepresented groups, other performers, to follow.

Margaret staunchly supports the causes that are important to her: anti-racism, anti-bullying, gay rights, all while fulfilling her successful creative side with a legendary stand up career that has yielded 10-plus comedy tours. Her recent television & movie roles include “Erin” in HULU’s smash Fire Island, guest starring on the Ryan Murphy hit Doctor Odyssey , The Flight Attendant (HBO Max), Hacks (HBO Max) and two Netflix is a Joke comedy specials including Outstanding: A Comedy Revolution . Margaret’s latest film, All That We Love , premiered at the Tribeca Film Festival, earning Margaret rave reviews, and she is set to star as “Wasp,” one of the “Gray Sisters” in Season 2 of Disney’s Percy Jackson and the Olympians as well as in Gregg Araki’s movie thriller I Want Your Sex .

Margaret, who Vogue magazine named one of the 9 best female comedians of all time, alongside Joan Rivers, Gilda Radner and Wanda Sykes, appreciates where she finds herself right now. “I think comedians in general, we get better as we get older, and we kind of get more observant, and more astute in those observations."

Thankfully, Margaret has more stories to tell, and her production company, Animal Family Productions , has multiple scripted shows in development for 2024 and beyond.

PLEASE NOTE: This show is not for the faint of heart. Expect graphic content, explicit sexual humor, strong language, and boundary-pushing material. Recommended for audiences who aren’t easily offended.

description:
Using his experiences growing up in Newark, Bill Bellamy started doing stand-up while he was a student at Rutgers University. Bellamy quickly discovered how much he enjoyed making people laugh, and began honing his skills at small comedy clubs around the country and was soon making waves in the New York clubs like The Improv, The Comic Strip, and at The Comedy Store in Los Angeles.

In less than two years of launching his stand-up career, Bellamy earned a spot on HBO’s DEF COMEDY JAM where he notoriously coined the phrase “Booty Call.” The now famous late-night rendez-vous moniker became the name for his first comedy special for Showtime; “Booty Call” and it was instantly one of the network’s top-rated specials.

Bellamy became a staple on MTV as one of the first “VJs” on the network. He hosted several of their programming blocks, including MTV JAMS and MTV BEACH HOUSE, while interviewing everyone from the late Kurt Cobain to Janet Jackson. In 1996, Bill landed his own series, “The Billy Bellamy Show.”

Bill starred in the syndicated show MR. BOX OFFICE alongside along side Jon Lovitz, Tim Meadows, and Viveca J. Fox. Prior to MR. BOX OFFICE Bellamy has appeared on recurring episodes of Tyler Perry’s MEET THE BROWNS/TBS and has guest-starred on ABC’s CASTLE, USA’s ROYAL PAINS, USA’s WHITE COLLAR & TNT’s MURDER IN THE FIRST. Previously, Bill hosted four seasons of the TV One comedy competition show WHO’S GOT JOKES? and two seasons of NBC’s Emmy Nominated LAST COMIC STANDING.

Bellamy also continued to star on the big screen in addition to garnering coveted guest roles in several prominent television series. In the feature world, Bellamy starred in LOVE JONES, HOW TO BE A PLAYER, LOVE STINKS, THE BROTHERS, and ANY GIVEN SUNDAY. At the same time, showcasing his mutli-hyphenate talents, Bellamy continued to hone his comedy and stand-up prowess. He debuted his second comedy special, CRAZY SEXY DIRTY in May 2012, it was one of the highest rated comedy specials of their…

From showrooms in Las Vegas to Royal Caribbean Cruise Line stages around the world, John delivers dynamic, out-of-the-box performances that leave audiences laughing, amazed, and coming back for more.

This stage hypnosis show reimagines a centuries-old art form. Set to modern music and infused with pop culture, it’s fun, fast-paced, and packed with energy, making it a hit with audiences of all ages. He’s opened for dozens of nationally touring comedians and local legends alike. He has received numerous accolades in comedy competitions such as the prestigious "participation award" in the Rocky Mountain Laugh Off.

Seth is a U of U basketball alumnus. During his time on the team he was banned from doing comedy because his jokes made shooting percentages go down. He was so hilarious they lost the Mountain West tournament handily. After immediately being cut from the team for incompetence, he realized that his only remaining talent lay in comedy.

Seth’s comedy style mostly features personal stories, passionate ramblings, and $6 words. You’ll enjoy laughing along with Seth’s clever wit, but make sure you pay attention, or you might miss a joke amongst his fast-talk and booming voice.

description:
A regular on the Sydney comedy circuit,  Jenny Tian  exploded onto our #fyp during the pandemic notching up millions of likes and amassing a collective online audience of 1M+. Her debut solo show Picture This sold out to audiences up and down the east coast of Australia and was released as a YouTube special where it has nearly a million views. Mike has performed everywhere from dive bars to Carnegie Hall. Originally from Norway, Daniel Simonsen is a Norwegian/Chilean stand-up comedian. He can be seen in Stavros Halkias’s feature, Let’s Start A Cult on Hulu and Joe Pera's new Adult Swim series, My Two Cars. Daniel regularly opens for Louis CK and has also opened for Stavros Halkias, Bert Kreischer, Ari Shaffir, and performed at Dave Chappelle’s YS Firehouse. He made his US late-night debut on Late Night with Seth Meyers. He has since appeared on CC Stand-Up Featuring, The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, Stavvy’s World, and recurred on Comedy Central’s This Week at the Comedy Cellar. Daniel’s Colbert performance was reviewed by Vulture. He was named NY's Funniest at the NYCF and performs at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival regularly. He won UK’s So You Think You’re Funny award and went on to win the Best Newcomer award after that.

While in the UK, Daniel had a recurring role on Vic and Bob’s BBC sitcom, House of Fools and ITV’s Timewasters. He created and wrote his own digital series for ALL4 called, Daniel directed by Andrew Gaynord (People of the Earth, Netflix Presents: The Characters, Detroiters, Stath Lets Flats, etc.) that starred him, Natasia Demetriou, and Brett Goldstein. He also appeared on Russell Howard’s Good News. He is a Comedy Cellar regular and tours nationwide and internationally.

Step beyond the charming storefronts and sunny sidewalks into the shadowy stories of Chandler’s past on this 75-minute guided walking ghost tour, starting and ending at Mic Drop Comedy Chandler (📍 51 E Boston St, Chandler, AZ 85225 ).

As the sun dips low and the streets grow quiet, you’ll follow your guide through historic downtown Chandler, where whispers of the past still echo between the bricks. We’ll journey through nearly a century of hidden history—from haunted hotels where the scent of cigar smoke hangs heavy in empty halls, to ghostly theaters where the reels still spin for no one. You’ll pass buildings where electricity first sparked to life—and may still flicker thanks to something unseen.

Hear tales of vanished cowboys, mysterious phone calls from empty rooms, unexplained cold spots, and the eerie scent of old medicine drifting through shuttered windows. These aren’t just ghost stories—they’re hometown legends, stitched into the bones of Chandler itself.

Whether you're a curious skeptic, a paranormal enthusiast, or just looking for a memorable night out, this immersive tour promises a walk through Chandler you’ll never forget—and may not want to walk alone.

description: Our show tells a completely improvised story, BACKWARDS! It’s an improvised play that starts at the end and ends at the start! With just a single word of inspiration taken from the audience, the show starts with the final scene of the story and the performers work backwards from there to find out what happened before that, and before that, and so on. With each preceding scene exploring what caused that final (first!) scene to be. Each new scene jumps back in time; sometimes by a little, sometimes by a lot, and in each new scene you will discover a new element of the tale, bit by bit piecing together how the story came together so that, by the end, everything has become clear! Once the story has gone all the way back to the start, the show then crescendos, going back to that first (final!) scene to see it again in a whole new light, having now experienced all the parts of the story that lead up to this moment. From discovering why a bride ran out on her wedding, to finding out why that
