George Lopez’s multi-faceted career encompasses television, film, standup comedy, and late-night television.

Lopez can be seen in his Netflix original comedy special We’ll Do It For Half which premiered globally over the summer. Last year Lopez was on tour nationwide for his stand-up comedy The Wall World. He also completed his tour for The Comedy Get Down, along with Eddie Griffin, D.L. Hughley, and Cedric the Entertainer. The comedians also debuted their BET scripted comedy series based on the tour.

Lopez has been featured in four HBO specials, The Wall in August 2017, It’s Not Me, It’s You in 2012, GRAMMY nominated Best Comedy Album Tall, Dark and Chicano in 2009, and America's Mexican in 2007. Lopez also performed as part of HBO and TBS's Comic Relief 2006. His acclaimed comedy concert, Why You Crying?, debuted on Showtime in 2004. He released his third standup CD, El Mas Chingon, in 2006, which also earned Lopez a GRAMMY nomination in the category of Best Comedy Album. In 2004, he was nominated for a GRAMMY in the same category for his CD Team Leader.

He also starred in Lopez on TV Land. Produced by Lopez, the series explored how he struggled between his two worlds and crises that are often of his own making. The half hour single camera serialized comedy aired for two seasons. Lopez Tonight, a late-night television talk show on TBS, also ran for two seasons. It represented Lopez's return to series television after co-creating, writing, producing, and starring in Warner Bros. Television's groundbreaking hit sitcom George Lopez, which ran for six seasons on ABC. George Lopez remains a hit with viewers in syndication on both broadcast stations and cable's Nick at Nite, ranking as one of the top-rated shows on the network and among the top five comedies and top 20 weekly programs in syndication.

description:
Preacher Lawson is a comedian, actor, and creator based in Los Angeles known for his high-energy storytelling and physical, joy-driven comedy. Performing stand-up since the age of 16, Lawson first gained major industry recognition after winning the 2016 Seattle International Comedy Competition. He rose to international acclaim in 2017 as a finalist on Season 12 of  America's Got Talent , quickly becoming a fan favorite for his high-energy performances and charismatic stage presence. He later returned for  America's Got Talent: The Champions  in 2019, where he finished in the Top 5. In the years following Lawson has built a global fanbase through touring, a massive social media following, and multiple comedy specials which have accumulated millions of views.

On the film and television side, Lawson starred as a series regular on NBC’s  Connecting  and has appeared on the Emmy-winning Netflix series  I Think You Should Leave with Tim Robinson   as well as HBO’s  A Black Lady Sketch Show . In January 2026, he released his third stand-up special,  Keep Preacher Weird , to widespread critical and commercial praise. Raised in a military family and shaped by life on the move, Preacher’s comedy centers on resilience, relationships, and finding humor in chaos; qualities highlighted in his first two specials:  Get to Know Me  and  My Name Is Preacher .

Beyond stand-up, he creates digital content, develops film and TV projects, and collaborates with other comedians and creators. His work has been featured on NBC, Netflix Is a Joke, and major comedy festivals around the world.

description:
Charles McBee is a NYC stand-up comedian, writer, and unapologetic 80s/'90s baby from Toledo, Ohio, serving up nostalgia with a side of truth. Whether he's breaking down the wild logic of gym class dodgeball or reminding you what it meant to record songs off the radio without your mom yelling in the background, Charles brings hilarious, heartfelt commentary about growing up in a pre-WiFi world straight to the stage.

He’s made three national appearances on Gotham Comedy Live, was a standout on FOX’s Laughs and Punchline (Seasons 1 & 2), and has written for everything from VH1's Hip Hop Honors to the 2020 VMAs and the 2021 Golden Globes. He most recently served as Head Writer for Comedy Central’s Hell of a Week with Charlamagne Tha God, earning a Writers Guild Award nomination, and was a creative consultant on Nick Cannon’s Wild' N Out.

Charles has also built a dedicated social media following with his no-holds-barred takes on pop culture, politics, and the beautiful chaos of growing up in the analog era.

If you’ve ever eaten a microwave dinner on a folding tray table, feared getting caught in a game of freeze tag, or lived through dial-up internet, Charles has a joke for you. Come see why his fans keep coming back.

description:
Rhys Darby is an actor, writer, podcaster and stand-up comedian from New Zealand.

Darby first captured US audiences as Murray, the loveable, but ultimately inept manager in HBO’s Flight of the Conchords. He has gone on to star in a plethora of TV and film roles, from Yes Man and Pirate Radio (The Boat that Rocked) to Nigel in the Jumanji reboots. On the small screen he has brought his talents to animations like Voltron Legendary Defender and Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, and shows like TBS’ Wrecked, The X Files and Lemony Snicket. Most recently he starred as the gentleman pirate, Stede Bonnet in Our Flag Means Death.

Darby is never far from his stand-up roots. His stand-up has been described as a sensational blend of sound effects, characterizations and askew observations. Rhys has five stand-up specials’, Imagine That! (2008), It’s Rhys Darby Night! (2011) and This Way to Spaceship, (2012) and I’m a Fighter Jet (2017) and Mystic Time Bird (2021). This Way to Spaceship was based on his debut novel of the same name, “A loosely autobiographical end of world companion” in 2012. It was number 1 in the international charts for 7 weeks.
Darby’s second book, this time for kids, was released in Australia and New Zealand in October 2018. It is called The Top Secret Notes of Buttons McGinty. Darby wrote it for his then 8-year-old son, a reluctant reader, and has been thrilled to hear from kids and parents that they love it! He went on to release another two Buttons books, which thrilled his legions of junior fans.

Rhys’ love of the weird is seen in his stand-up and writing, and for ten years he has had first a radio show, then a podcast on cryptozoology, The Cryptid Factor. Darby was thrilled when approached by Spotify to do a podcast about aliens, Aliens like Us. A regular attendee of alien conferences and stargazer, it was a dream come true.
A prolific voice-over artist, kids all over the world hear him in Voltron: Legendary defender, Spirit, TMNT, Boss Baby, Jake and…

George Lopez’s multi-faceted career encompasses television, film, standup comedy, and late-night television.

Lopez can be seen in his Netflix original comedy special We’ll Do It For Half which premiered globally over the summer. Last year Lopez was on tour nationwide for his stand-up comedy The Wall World. He also completed his tour for The Comedy Get Down, along with Eddie Griffin, D.L. Hughley, and Cedric the Entertainer. The comedians also debuted their BET scripted comedy series based on the tour.

Lopez has been featured in four HBO specials, The Wall in August 2017, It’s Not Me, It’s You in 2012, GRAMMY nominated Best Comedy Album Tall, Dark and Chicano in 2009, and America's Mexican in 2007. Lopez also performed as part of HBO and TBS's Comic Relief 2006. His acclaimed comedy concert, Why You Crying?, debuted on Showtime in 2004. He released his third standup CD, El Mas Chingon, in 2006, which also earned Lopez a GRAMMY nomination in the category of Best Comedy Album. In 2004, he was nominated for a GRAMMY in the same category for his CD Team Leader.

He also starred in Lopez on TV Land. Produced by Lopez, the series explored how he struggled between his two worlds and crises that are often of his own making. The half hour single camera serialized comedy aired for two seasons. Lopez Tonight, a late-night television talk show on TBS, also ran for two seasons. It represented Lopez's return to series television after co-creating, writing, producing, and starring in Warner Bros. Television's groundbreaking hit sitcom George Lopez, which ran for six seasons on ABC. George Lopez remains a hit with viewers in syndication on both broadcast stations and cable's Nick at Nite, ranking as one of the top-rated shows on the network and among the top five comedies and top 20 weekly programs in syndication.

description:
Preacher Lawson is a comedian, actor, and creator based in Los Angeles known for his high-energy storytelling and physical, joy-driven comedy. Performing stand-up since the age of 16, Lawson first gained major industry recognition after winning the 2016 Seattle International Comedy Competition. He rose to international acclaim in 2017 as a finalist on Season 12 of  America's Got Talent , quickly becoming a fan favorite for his high-energy performances and charismatic stage presence. He later returned for  America's Got Talent: The Champions  in 2019, where he finished in the Top 5. In the years following Lawson has built a global fanbase through touring, a massive social media following, and multiple comedy specials which have accumulated millions of views.

On the film and television side, Lawson starred as a series regular on NBC’s  Connecting  and has appeared on the Emmy-winning Netflix series  I Think You Should Leave with Tim Robinson   as well as HBO’s  A Black Lady Sketch Show . In January 2026, he released his third stand-up special,  Keep Preacher Weird , to widespread critical and commercial praise. Raised in a military family and shaped by life on the move, Preacher’s comedy centers on resilience, relationships, and finding humor in chaos; qualities highlighted in his first two specials:  Get to Know Me  and  My Name Is Preacher .

Beyond stand-up, he creates digital content, develops film and TV projects, and collaborates with other comedians and creators. His work has been featured on NBC, Netflix Is a Joke, and major comedy festivals around the world.

description:
Charles McBee is a NYC stand-up comedian, writer, and unapologetic 80s/'90s baby from Toledo, Ohio, serving up nostalgia with a side of truth. Whether he's breaking down the wild logic of gym class dodgeball or reminding you what it meant to record songs off the radio without your mom yelling in the background, Charles brings hilarious, heartfelt commentary about growing up in a pre-WiFi world straight to the stage.

He’s made three national appearances on Gotham Comedy Live, was a standout on FOX’s Laughs and Punchline (Seasons 1 & 2), and has written for everything from VH1's Hip Hop Honors to the 2020 VMAs and the 2021 Golden Globes. He most recently served as Head Writer for Comedy Central’s Hell of a Week with Charlamagne Tha God, earning a Writers Guild Award nomination, and was a creative consultant on Nick Cannon’s Wild' N Out.

Charles has also built a dedicated social media following with his no-holds-barred takes on pop culture, politics, and the beautiful chaos of growing up in the analog era.

If you’ve ever eaten a microwave dinner on a folding tray table, feared getting caught in a game of freeze tag, or lived through dial-up internet, Charles has a joke for you. Come see why his fans keep coming back.

description:
👻  Whispers on Boston Street – Ghost Walk

History. Hauntings. Hometown Secrets.

Step beyond the charming storefronts and sunny sidewalks into the shadowy stories of Chandler’s past on this 75-minute guided walking ghost tour, starting and ending at Mic Drop Comedy Chandler (📍 51 E Boston St, Chandler, AZ 85225 ).

As the sun dips low and the streets grow quiet, you’ll follow your guide through historic downtown Chandler, where whispers of the past still echo between the bricks. We’ll journey through nearly a century of hidden history—from haunted hotels where the scent of cigar smoke hangs heavy in empty halls, to ghostly theaters where the reels still spin for no one. You’ll pass buildings where electricity first sparked to life—and may still flicker thanks to something unseen.

Hear tales of vanished cowboys, mysterious phone calls from empty rooms, unexplained cold spots, and the eerie scent of old medicine drifting through shuttered windows. These aren’t just ghost stories—they’re hometown legends, stitched into the bones of Chandler itself.

Whether you're a curious skeptic, a paranormal enthusiast, or just looking for a memorable night out, this immersive tour promises a walk through Chandler you’ll never forget—and may not want to walk alone.

description:
Known to you as the students who were always the loud kids in the back of the classroom, the Unteachables are a group of stand-up comedians who just happened to fall backwards into educating America’s youth. Their material extends far beyond just the chaos that exists in their classroom. They offer authentic comedy to everyone, regardless of if they've worked in education, need a break from reality, or just love to laugh. The Unteachables have been featured on NBC, The Breakfast Club, and The New York Post.

Stephen Taylor

Originally a Louisiana native, Stephen moved to Kansas City to escape his traditional southern roots. Combining his unique perspective with some interesting stories and some sweet southern charm, Stephen headlines and features at your favorite clubs, bars, and colleges across the country, as well as his own classroom. He has been featured on The Breakfast Club, The New York Post, and at San Francisco Sketchfest. His debut special 'The Bottom Half' charted to #1 on iTunes and can be seen on Amazon and Apple TV.

Lou Pharis

Raised in the non-famous parts of Louisiana, Lou Pharis never thought he’d be anything more than an NFL caliber offensive lineman. After failing to go pro and then losing out on American Ninja Warrior, Lou turned his talents to the public education system. A particularly rough day at school made Lou sign up for his first open mic when he realized there’s a teacher shortage, so he couldn’t be fired for doing comedy. Lou’s stand-up has since found massive success, garnering over 100 million views on social media. He now headlines clubs across the United States, has been seen on NBC and Bored Teachers, and has performed at dozens of comedy festivals across the country.

Miss Redacted

description:
🌵Desert Roots: Chandler History Walk

Discover Chandler’s Foundations with a Comedic Twist

Step off the beaten path and into the untamed past of downtown Chandler … where cattle once roamed, citrus bloomed, and pioneers laid the groundwork for one of Arizona’s fastest-growing cities.  Desert Roots  isn’t your average history tour … it’s a time-traveling stroll with a few extra punchlines, brought to you by the actual comedians of Mic Drop Comedy.

For 65 fascinating (and surprisingly funny) minutes, we’ll walk through the city’s historic core, unpacking stories of early 1900s general stores, silent film theaters, electric-firsts, and Chandler’s original vision for a community-centered desert oasis. You’ll learn about the legendary “Five C’s of Arizona,” tour preserved architectural gems, and uncover the lesser-known figures who helped shape this resilient town.

Join us for captivating history, local lore, and humor that hits harder than an Arizona summer. Whether you’re a local, a curious traveler, or someone who just appreciates a side of sarcasm with their civic facts, this tour is for you.

description:
🛸 UFOs, Myths & Mysteries: Strange Chandler

A Walking Tour Through the Weird, the Wild, and the Unexplained

Chandler may look quiet under the desert sky, but history suggests we’re not always alone.

UFOs, Myths & Mysteries: Strange Chandler is a guided walking tour exploring the city’s strangest stories: unexplained lights, lost time, electromagnetic anomalies, Indigenous sky legends, and real incidents documented in police logs, maintenance records, and eyewitness accounts.

From the night of the 1997 Phoenix Lights , when clocks reportedly stopped downtown, to shimmering fountains, glowing alleyways, sky serpents, and modern light installations that may be repeating old signals, this tour blends documented events, desert science, folklore, and pop-culture mystery into one unforgettable experience.

This isn’t a haunted house, and it’s not a lecture.

It’s a playful, eerie journey through Chandler’s most curious moments, told with humor, history, and just enough “what if?” to keep you looking up.

You’ll walk the same streets where:

witnesses reported hovering craft and power surges

water rippled without wind

time seemed to skip

lights appeared, vanished, and sometimes came back

Whether you believe these stories are extraterrestrial, scientific, psychological, or something else entirely … Strange Chandler invites you to decide for yourself.

📍 Start & End: Mic Drop Comedy, 51 E Boston St

🚶 Distance: ~½ mile loop

⏰ Duration: ~50 minutes

👟 Please wear comfortable walking shoes

👽 Recommended for teens & adults

Perfect for locals, visitors, skeptics, sci-fi fans, and anyone who enjoys history with a strange twist.

Some towns have ghost stories.

Come walk beneath the lights, and see what notices you back.

description: Three idiots open a milkshake stand with a revolutionary idea: human-flavoured milkshakes. It’s bold. It’s original. It’s a terrible plan. Try one—they’re bloody delicious. From interrogating a robber about his career choices, to being chased by vultures desperate for a sip, to sourcing ingredients in ways that raise serious ethical questions, their business spirals through one ridiculous situation after another. With surreal, sketch-show logic, mime, and high-energy physical comedy, nothing behaves as it should. This is a fast, chaotic ride through the rise and fall of a very bad idea. You laugh at them. You laugh with them. Mostly, you wonder how they’re still open. Created and performed by Paul Kelvin, Elsa Mills, and Gabriel Parker-Ellwood, this marks their debut as a company.
title: Milkshakes Milkshakes Milkshakes

description: ★★★★ “A hilarious mash-up of folk song, dance and storytelling" - StageTalk Magazine It’s been raining all summer. But that’s not going to stop the residents of Hopley Drew gathering in The Barleycorn Inn for their annual village show and one final knees up before the pub closes its doors for good. As the villagers show off their soggy crops, share songs and tales of local lore, and wait with baited breath for the results of the raffle, a wild storm rages. Some say it’s just typical British weather, but others say it’s something much more sinister... Can this drenched and disenchanted community band together to overcome whatever lurks outside? description: In 2023, Joe Leather was chasing his dreams of an Edinburgh Fringe debut, when...ping! A herniated disc! Some people survive shark attacks; Joe stretched too enthusiastically. Refusing to accept such a humble beginning, Joe rewrites history live onstage to find a 'back' story worthy of the painful consequences. Baby Got Back (Problems) is a musical comedy about ambition, bad timing and the absolute audacity of the human spine. It's a show for anyone who’s ever thought "this is going to be my year..." then had to lie down for a while. Offie-winner Joe Leather blends musical comedy, puppetry and genre-bending storytelling in a show about pain, performance and the desperate human need to turn random suffering into a good tale(bone).

Themes include cringing, dung beetles, crocodiles and so much more. Come along and feel the lurve. Mahala Roberts is a psychiatrist and creative. She hit the menopause and had a midlife crisis with a difference. She had a creative explosion and turned it into a one woman show!! She channelled all those weird crazy chaotic menopausal emotions into a warm, quirky and very funny show. Mahala Roberts is a fifty plus woman, who after many years of holding it all in, has decided to let go BIG TIME.

description: Clown duo Plowman and Cummins present a surreal trip to the hairdressers. Expect bouncy blow-dries, falling over, mess, beauty, violence and classical singing. Using absurd visual comedy, physical theatre and splintered narrative, Plowman and Cummins herald a slapstick revival. The salon dissolves into moments of chaos, danger and silliness as objects, costumes and bodies morph in and out of reality. Part-clown part-performance art, ‘Plowman and Cummins are Plowman and Cummins’ is their debut hour-long comedy show, appearing at Brighton Fringe for the very first time. For fans of foolishness, laughing and the feeling you get when you watch someone run for the bus as it drives away.
title: Plowman and Cummins are Plowman and Cummins

description: Now in her fifties, Jules O’Brian has become a magnet for advice she never asked for. What to wear. How to behave. How to age “gracefully”. And which inspirational quotes she should apparently be living by. She’s not having it. A former English teacher turned stand-up, Jules takes aim at the clichés, unsolicited opinions and well-meaning nonsense that seem to multiply the older you get. From strangers offering life advice to the constant pressure to shrink, behave and be grateful for it. Warm, sharp and very funny, this is a show about getting older, getting wiser, and deciding which bits of advice can get in the bin.
title: Jules O’Brian: Avoid Excessive Cleavage (and Other Advice to Ignore)

description: From Drag to Deuteronomy, this show has everything! Mega Church Xmas Play is a surreal, absurd, irreverent farce exploring the competitive side of the entertainment industry, organised religion and man buns. Devoted followers of Mega Church "Skylife" are preparing their annual Xmas play, but will ruthless ambition, ego and jealousy consume them? GOD wants this year's Xmas show to be the BIGGEST and BEST in the WORLD, putting senior pastor Cole Crampson under immense pressure. The hard working church members are competing for the lead roles, but will talented newcomers from rival Mega Church "EarthHeaven" take their place? Who will be crucified before curtain call?
title: Mega Church Xmas Play

description: She's peopled her last please, now she's figuring out hey ‘why can’t she be desired’? Why can’t she be naughty? Why can’t she be made out of HDPE plastic? Her exterior’s hard plastic but inside she's stagnant air from 1991. Bex can’t hide behind a toy kitchen mask anymore... she's 5ft8. A fragile woman made entity! Whose masquerading as someone whose normal. But not really. Instead of sharp edges Bex has soft curves, a sturdy base and a small rack. Who is she but a toy kitchen? Join whimsical and (sometimes scary) comedian Bex Turner for a (mostly) stand-up show of weird tales, Autism and lots of crude Crudités! Bex Turner is a high energy, eccentric, surreal, stand up/character comic. Her likeability combined with her comedic sense of adventure makes audiences love her. She was a 2018 Quarter Finalist at Leicester Square New Comedian of the Year and a 2015 Semi Finalist for Laughing Horse New Act of the Year.
title: Momma’s Got a Brand New Toy Kitchen

description:
Open Mic Night - this is where it begins.

Wiseguys Open Mic is a weekly showcase of Utah's best up-and-coming performers. Each show is a hilarious mix of professionals working on new material, amateur comedians working on their chops, and first-timers being thrown in the mix.

Wiseguys Open Mic is held every Wednesday at Wiseguys Downtown SLC at the Gateway.

How do I sign up?

Please email  [contact removed]  and request a spot on the next open mic. You may submit one email request for  yourself only  up to one week before the next scheduled open mic. You may not request a spot several weeks in advance of the night you'd like to perform. Anyone interested in performing on Open Mic night must send in an email request; there are no longer sign-ups the night of the show. If you are selected to do a spot, we will respond to your email. It is up to you to check your email.

If you are a comic visiting from out of town, please email us and we will try to make room for you. All performers must be aged 21 or older.

How will I know if I'm on the show?

We will respond via email to everyone who will be on the open mic no later than 6pm the Tuesday before open mic. If you are selected, feel free to invite friends and family to come watch and support your performance. Admission is $5 for audience members and free for performers. It is your responsibility to check your email to see if you've been selected.

What if I'm not chosen to be on the show?

We do our best to give everyone an opportunity to perform but we can't always squeeze everyone on to the show because of high demand. If you are not selected to perform, keep sending in email requests. Be persistent and patient (and nice) and we will make sure you have an opportunity to take the stage. If you’re not selected, please come to the show and support anyway. Your support of the other open mic performers is noticed and appreciated and won’t hurt your chances to be selected for a future open mic.

description: This year, Caitlin Powell finished a PhD on fascism (yikes) and promptly crashed out – a reasonable response given *it all*. We’ll See About That! is for anyone who wants to fix the world but can’t even get a hold of their landlord. It’s about meal deals, moon cups, and the nagging feeling that constantly bracing for disaster is getting in the way of being a cool fun time. This is a show for the girls, gays, theys (and anyone with the pattern recognition of a bloodhound). Caitlin Powell is a ‘brilliant’ (Jen Brister) and ‘delightfully self-effacing’ (Chortle) rising star on the circuit. They have been a finalist in the Funny Women Awards, Chortle Student Comedy Awards, and LGBTQ+ New Comedian of the Year, and a two-time nominee for the BBC New Comedy Awards. Their podcast Queers Gone By has been described as ‘utterly hilarious’ (The Guardian), ‘laugh-out-loud’ (GQ) and ‘idiotic’ (Men’s Health).

description: Super Dropper is a one-woman comedy show inspired by juggling. Irreverent, cheeky and flirtatious, Super Dropper is passionate about juggling! Thanks to her juggling props, she expresses her weirdest philosophical thoughts and fantasies without filters. She sees the world falling apart and she really wants to fix it! Her plan? Spreading the juggling love to save the world. The sky is her limit! Super Dropper mixes comedy and circus. Halfway between autobiography and fiction, Super Dropper explores with a French touch the themes of failure, introspection and politics. Expect puns, wit and speaking balls!

He has appeared on COMEDY CENTRAL, AFTER MIDNIGHT on CBS, and has made two appearances on THE TONIGHT SHOW STARRING JIMMY FALLON where he received a standing ovation both times. In fact, his first performance went so well that Jimmy hired him to be a staff writer. He has also written for VICELAND, NETFLIX and BET. He was a highlight at the prestigious Just For Laughs festival in Montreal as a New Face and was a finalist for Stand Up NBC. Jourdain has also performed at numerous festivals including SXSW, Moontower, Laugh Your Asheville Off, Laughing Skull, and Riot Comedy Fest. Jourdain has gained attention on social media platforms with numerous viral clips racking up millions of views on TikTok and Instagram. His debut Comedy Album “Good For You” can be found on all streaming platforms. When he is not touring he resides in New York City where he is a regular at The Comedy Cellar and Gotham Comedy Club.

description:
Recently named one of Variety’s Top 10 Comics to Watch, Detroit native Joe Dombrowski first caught the world’s attention in 2017 with a viral April Fools’ Day spelling test prank that led to multiple appearances on The Ellen DeGeneres Show. Don’t get it twisted, though—it takes 20 years to be an overnight sensation! Joe’s been performing stand-up since his third-grade talent show, and he hasn’t stopped since.

Today, Joe tours internationally with material that highlights his marriage, being a new dad, his accidentally hilarious parents and unforgettable years as an elementary school teacher. His comedy has been featured on The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, the Just For Laughs Festival in Montreal, the New York Comedy Festival, and Netflix Is a Joke Fest.

Joe is also the co-host of the hit live comedy/game show My Straight Friends, running monthly at The World Famous Comedy Store in Los Angeles and Emerald City Comedy Club in Seattle. Joe currently resides in Seattle, Washington where he hopes to run for Mayor sometime. And by Mayor he means PTA president.
title: Joe Dombrowski

description:
Usama Siddiquee is a Bengali-American stand-up comedian, writer, and actor based in New York City, who can most recently be seen as a finalist (and fan favorite!) on Kevin Hart’s new series for Netflix,  Funny AF .

As an actor, Usama can be seen scene-stealing in Netflix’s  Inventing Anna   and   Survival of the Thickest , HBO’s  And Just Like That ,  Comedy Central’s  Awkwafina Is Nora from Queens ,  and FX’s  Better Things .  He recently wrapped a supporting role in the upcoming Netflix comedy  Best of the Best ,  alongside Hasan Minhaj, Priyanka Kedia, and Maitreyi Ramakrishnan.

In 2024, Usama made his late-night debut on  The Late Show with Stephen Colbert ,  and in 2025 released his first half-hour special with Don’t Tell Comedy on YouTube. The special highlights his signature high-energy, rapid-fire style, with material ranging from growing up Muslim in Texas to dating misadventures and even getting kicked off  America’s Got Talent . Usama was named a New Face at the prestigious Just For Laughs Festival in 2018.

Chico contributed his skills to the long-running sketch-variety television show "Wild N' Out" hosted weekly by Nick Cannon and helped catapult the show to high viewership. Nataly Aukar is a Lebanese born and raised writer and performer based in NYC. As a stand-up comic, Nataly has toured the world, opening for comedians such as Ramy Youssef (Ramy), Mo Amer (Mo, Black Adam), and Gad El Maleh (Huge in France) and was featured on Don’t Tell Comedy, and in the Netflix is a Joke Festival as part of the “Introducing…” showcase. She also starred, alongside Succession’s Hiam Abbas, in Noa Osheroff’s short film Sofa So Good which was highlighted in The New Yorker.

Nataly can be seen in the Netflix feature The Life List, directed by Adam Brooks and just wrapped the indie feature Skit written and directed by Badr Mastrouq and Des Lombardo. She is touring her new hour all across North America, the United Kingdom and the Middle East. She was recently featured on Vulture's 2025 "The Comedians You Should and Will Know of 2025."

description:
Recently named one of Variety’s Top 10 Comics to Watch, Detroit native Joe Dombrowski first caught the world’s attention in 2017 with a viral April Fools’ Day spelling test prank that led to multiple appearances on The Ellen DeGeneres Show. Don’t get it twisted, though—it takes 20 years to be an overnight sensation! Joe’s been performing stand-up since his third-grade talent show, and he hasn’t stopped since.

Today, Joe tours internationally with material that highlights his marriage, being a new dad, his accidentally hilarious parents and unforgettable years as an elementary school teacher. His comedy has been featured on The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, the Just For Laughs Festival in Montreal, the New York Comedy Festival, and Netflix Is a Joke Fest.

Joe is also the co-host of the hit live comedy/game show My Straight Friends, running monthly at The World Famous Comedy Store in Los Angeles and Emerald City Comedy Club in Seattle. Joe currently resides in Seattle, Washington where he hopes to run for Mayor sometime. And by Mayor he means PTA president.

Nataly Aukar is a Lebanese born and raised writer and performer based in NYC. As a stand-up comic, Nataly has toured the world, opening for comedians such as Ramy Youssef (Ramy), Mo Amer (Mo, Black Adam), and Gad El Maleh (Huge in France) and was featured on Don’t Tell Comedy, and in the Netflix is a Joke Festival as part of the “Introducing…” showcase. She also starred, alongside Succession’s Hiam Abbas, in Noa Osheroff’s short film Sofa So Good which was highlighted in The New Yorker.

Usama Siddiquee is a Bengali-American stand-up comedian, writer, and actor based in New York City, who can most recently be seen as a finalist (and fan favorite!) on Kevin Hart’s new series for Netflix,  Funny AF .

As an actor, Usama can be seen scene-stealing in Netflix’s  Inventing Anna   and   Survival of the Thickest , HBO’s  And Just Like That ,  Comedy Central’s  Awkwafina Is Nora from Queens ,  and FX’s  Better Things .  He recently wrapped a supporting role in the upcoming Netflix comedy  Best of the Best ,  alongside Hasan Minhaj, Priyanka Kedia, and Maitreyi Ramakrishnan.

description:
Recently named one of Variety’s Top 10 Comics to Watch, Detroit native Joe Dombrowski first caught the world’s attention in 2017 with a viral April Fools’ Day spelling test prank that led to multiple appearances on The Ellen DeGeneres Show. Don’t get it twisted, though—it takes 20 years to be an overnight sensation! Joe’s been performing stand-up since his third-grade talent show, and he hasn’t stopped since.

Today, Joe tours internationally with material that highlights his marriage, being a new dad, his accidentally hilarious parents and unforgettable years as an elementary school teacher. His comedy has been featured on The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, the Just For Laughs Festival in Montreal, the New York Comedy Festival, and Netflix Is a Joke Fest.

Joe is also the co-host of the hit live comedy/game show My Straight Friends, running monthly at The World Famous Comedy Store in Los Angeles and Emerald City Comedy Club in Seattle. Joe currently resides in Seattle, Washington where he hopes to run for Mayor sometime. And by Mayor he means PTA president.

As gossip spreads through her tight-knit neighbourhood faster than the morning post, Donna must navigate solicitors, awkward encounters, unexpected allies and the chaos of rebuilding her life while trying to hold her family together. With a sharp-tongued best friend by her side, a very questionable postman never too far away, and an ex-husband determined to rewrite history, Donna soon discovers that standing up for yourself is never as straightforward as it seems. Packed with outrageous comedy, heartfelt moments, and an original score bursting with wit, warmth and 80s-inspired energy, In Her Defence is a celebration of resilience, friendship and finding your voice when the world expects you to stay silent. As an actor, Usama can be seen scene-stealing in Netflix’s  Inventing Anna   and   Survival of the Thickest , HBO’s  And Just Like That ,  Comedy Central’s  Awkwafina Is Nora from Queens ,  and FX’s  Better Things .  He recently wrapped a supporting role in the upcoming Netflix comedy  Best of the Best ,  alongside Hasan Minhaj, Priyanka Kedia, and Maitreyi Ramakrishnan.

In 2024, Usama made his late-night debut on  The Late Show with Stephen Colbert ,  and in 2025 released his first half-hour special with Don’t Tell Comedy on YouTube. The special highlights his signature high-energy, rapid-fire style, with material ranging from growing up Muslim in Texas to dating misadventures and even getting kicked off  America’s Got Talent . Usama was named a New Face at the prestigious Just For Laughs Festival in 2018.

description:
Hailing from Washington D.C. and known as 1⁄3 of the 85 South Show,  Chico Bean  knows how to deliver a well-executed joke. Born Anthony Bean, Chico Bean has the uncanny ability to memorize almost instantly the words to an old song or create a new quirky jingle on the spot. Chico contributed his skills to the long-running sketch-variety television show "Wild N' Out" hosted weekly by Nick Cannon and helped catapult the show to high viewership. Other credits include the Freestyle Funny Comedy Show and MTV 2's Guy Court. More recently, you can see Chico Bean on set with the entire 85 South Show cracking jokes and speaking on topics that matter. Writing and acting are other talents that Chico Bean showcases throughout his career, and more recently on E! His myriad of skills and "comedic improvisation" is what keeps the fans coming back for more. If you are looking for a fresh, funny, relative, and stand out comedian, look no further than Chico Bean

description:
Prepare for laughter galore with Jess Hilarious, the comedian with a gift for hilarious one-liners and an irresistible sense of humor. You've seen her on hit shows like "Rel," "Wild 'N Out," and networks such BET, MTV, VH1, Comedy Central, and HBO's All Def Comedy, where she left a lasting impression with her unique comedic style. Jess's versatility as a comedian and actress is evident in her various projects listed on IMDb. Beyond her TV appearances, she also delights her fans with a multitude of original series produced on her YouTube channel. Jess keeps it real, infusing her comedy with relatable stories from her Baltimore upbringing. With over 5.8 million followers on Instagram, Jess invites her fans to join her on a hilarious journey. Catch her in action at sold-out shows across the country, where her fascinating stage presence and captivating storytelling leave audiences in stitches. In February 2023, Jess joined THE BREAKFAST CLUB as a co-host. The Breakfast Club airs every morning in over 100 Radio Markets across the nation.

description:
Recently named one of Variety’s Top 10 Comics to Watch, Detroit native Joe Dombrowski first caught the world’s attention in 2017 with a viral April Fools’ Day spelling test prank that led to multiple appearances on The Ellen DeGeneres Show. Don’t get it twisted, though—it takes 20 years to be an overnight sensation! Joe’s been performing stand-up since his third-grade talent show, and he hasn’t stopped since.

Today, Joe tours internationally with material that highlights his marriage, being a new dad, his accidentally hilarious parents and unforgettable years as an elementary school teacher. His comedy has been featured on The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, the Just For Laughs Festival in Montreal, the New York Comedy Festival, and Netflix Is a Joke Fest.

Joe is also the co-host of the hit live comedy/game show My Straight Friends, running monthly at The World Famous Comedy Store in Los Angeles and Emerald City Comedy Club in Seattle. Joe currently resides in Seattle, Washington where he hopes to run for Mayor sometime. And by Mayor he means PTA president.

description:
Recently named one of Variety’s Top 10 Comics to Watch, Detroit native Joe Dombrowski first caught the world’s attention in 2017 with a viral April Fools’ Day spelling test prank that led to multiple appearances on The Ellen DeGeneres Show. Don’t get it twisted, though—it takes 20 years to be an overnight sensation! Joe’s been performing stand-up since his third-grade talent show, and he hasn’t stopped since.

Today, Joe tours internationally with material that highlights his marriage, being a new dad, his accidentally hilarious parents and unforgettable years as an elementary school teacher. His comedy has been featured on The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, the Just For Laughs Festival in Montreal, the New York Comedy Festival, and Netflix Is a Joke Fest.

Joe is also the co-host of the hit live comedy/game show My Straight Friends, running monthly at The World Famous Comedy Store in Los Angeles and Emerald City Comedy Club in Seattle. Joe currently resides in Seattle, Washington where he hopes to run for Mayor sometime. And by Mayor he means PTA president.

description:
Usama Siddiquee is a Bengali-American stand-up comedian, writer, and actor based in New York City, who can most recently be seen as a finalist (and fan favorite!) on Kevin Hart’s new series for Netflix,  Funny AF .

As an actor, Usama can be seen scene-stealing in Netflix’s  Inventing Anna   and   Survival of the Thickest , HBO’s  And Just Like That ,  Comedy Central’s  Awkwafina Is Nora from Queens ,  and FX’s  Better Things .  He recently wrapped a supporting role in the upcoming Netflix comedy  Best of the Best ,  alongside Hasan Minhaj, Priyanka Kedia, and Maitreyi Ramakrishnan.

In 2024, Usama made his late-night debut on  The Late Show with Stephen Colbert ,  and in 2025 released his first half-hour special with Don’t Tell Comedy on YouTube. The special highlights his signature high-energy, rapid-fire style, with material ranging from growing up Muslim in Texas to dating misadventures and even getting kicked off  America’s Got Talent . Usama was named a New Face at the prestigious Just For Laughs Festival in 2018.

description:
Born as Carsen White but spiritually forged in the chaos of a 3 a.m. ER shift, Nurse Stankk is what happens when sleep deprivation, trauma, and dark humor evolve into a full-blown personality instead of a coping mechanism. Known for his chaotic storytelling, brutally honest takes, and slightly concerning level of transparency, Nurse Stankk has built a loyal online following of healthcare workers who finally feel seen… and civilians who are now mildly terrified to ever visit the ER again.

With millions of views across social media as [handle removed], Carsen has brought his unfiltered healthcare comedy from the internet to stages across the country. He has performed at iconic venues including the Comedy Store, Aspen Laugh Festival, Hero’s Off Duty Tour, and multiple Improvs nationwide.

Whether you’re a nurse, first responder, healthcare worker, or just emotionally unstable enough to relate, Nurse Stankk delivers the kind of comedy that feels like a post-shift breakdown with your funniest coworker.

description:

Born Anthony Bean, Chico Bean has the uncanny ability to memorize almost instantly the words to an old song or create a new quirky jingle on the spot. Chico contributed his skills to the long-running sketch-variety television show "Wild N' Out" hosted weekly by Nick Cannon and helped catapult the show to high viewership. Other credits include the Freestyle Funny Comedy Show and MTV 2's Guy Court. More recently, you can see Chico Bean on set with the entire 85 South Show cracking jokes and speaking on topics that matter. Writing and acting are other talents that Chico Bean showcases throughout his career, and more recently on E! His myriad of skills and "comedic improvisation" is what keeps the fans coming back for more. If you are looking for a fresh, funny, relative, and stand out comedian, look no further than Chico Bean

description:
Baltimore native Desi Alexander is a high-energy stand-up
comedian, writer, and director known for his fearless storytelling and
razor-sharp wit. What started as teaching by day and performing by night
quickly turned into a full-time calling — a destiny foreshadowed by the
name his late father gave him, inspired by a classic bit from Eddie
Murphy’s Delirious.

With an engaged following of more than 600,000 fans worldwide, Desi
has built a loyal audience drawn to his raw honesty, animated delivery,
and relatable edge. His upcoming comedy special Stress Signal expands on
the high-energy style that’s made him a crowd favorite across the
country.

Beyond the stage, Desi is the creative force behind Redeye Valley
Films. His action film Flood is streaming on Tubi, while his acclaimed
projects The Realtor (Amazon) and Check Please (Tubi) showcase his range
as a writer and director.

For the past eight years, Desi has toured and written alongside Jess
Hilarious and has shared the stage with comedy heavyweights including
Kevin Hart, Chris Tucker, Tommy Davidson, and Paul Mooney.

Now headlining his nationwide Stress Signal tour, Desi Alexander
brings explosive energy, sharp perspective, and unforgettable laughs to
stages across the country.

description:
Suzanne Lambert is a DC-based comedian, internet personality, and general menace. Known as “the Regina George liberal,” she delivers engaging and biting wit to an audience of over one million fans across TikTok and Instagram ([handle removed]).

Her style could best be described as quick, sharp, amused bewilderment; she pairs strangely strong opinions about inconsequential topics with beauty tips and hot political takes. Originally hailing from Georgia, she had a very normal upbringing in a gun-loving Bible Belt town and remains unaffected to this day.

She began performing comedy in 2018 after her ex-boyfriend told her he would dump her if she tried it; a true win-win scenario! She has performed at nationally acclaimed venues like the DC Improv, Laughing Skull, Arlington Drafthouse, Side Splitters and the legendary Friars Club. Suzanne has performed with national acts like Mark Normand, Katherine Blanford and Tony Woods.

ABOUT THE SHOW

Sam Kurnit  is a long-time member of the Vermont comedy community. You'll recognize him from improv shows, standup shows, working in the box office and sound booth, teaching, and even being the voice of our pre-show announcement!

He's also the Director of Education for Vermont Comedy Arts , and a pun enthusiast.

We're celebrating Sam turning 42 by letting him take the reins for one night only. We don't know exactly what he has planned, but we do know that it involves YOU! All he's told us is that the whole show will be a jam that anyone can play in .

description:
Cliff Cash is a nationally touring standup comic who got his start in North Carolina. People said “you should be a comedian” his whole life but that sounded just as abstract as “you should be president” or “you should be an astronaut".

But you can only run from fate for so long. In 2011 at the age of 31, Cash got up at his first open mic. He was in the middle of big financial troubles, his father in chemo, a failing business and a tumultuous relationship. That four minutes on stage breathed life back into him that he didn’t think was possible. He didn’t miss one after that for two years.

Within a year and a half he landed Comedy Central’s UpNEXT and Sirius XM, the next year he appeared on Laughs TV and won Port City’s Top Comic and Comedy Zone’s Almost Famous. He’s gone on to win SLO Comedy festival’s Best of the Fest, Denver Comedy Work’s Thick Skinned (twice) and has headlined shows at Altercation Comedy Festival, Treefort Festival, West End Comedy Festival and BackHand Comedy Festival.

He’s also been part of Standup NBC and Rooftop Comedy. Cash has a half hour on DRYBAR Comedy called “ God Needed a Driver” and his debut album “Halfway There” was released by StandUp! Records in 2021 and spent a week at #1 on the comedy charts.

Cliff Cash was raised on the far right end of the southern, conservative, evangelical spectrum and the result is the antithesis of what was intended. Cliff’s comedy tackles everything from racism to homophobia, greed and war to death and divorce. Don’t worry there’s some poop jokes mixed in. Cash takes the audience on a journey that’s more than just funny. You’ll think, you’ll feel, you may even cry a little but then you’ll laugh again. His comedy aims to shine the light of levity into the darkest corners or the human experience and by doing so; take some power away from the things that we fear and dread. “Laughter is the best medicine” became a cliche for a reason. It’s true. Cliff hopes it is at least because he doesn’t have health…

description:
Last year Michael Palascak appeared on Nateland Presents: The Showcase on YouTube. Michael also released his self-produced special He's Friendly  which has garnered over 215, 000 views on YouTube and has multiple tracks streaming on Sirius XM’s comedy channels like Pure Comedy. You can also find him on Paramount + where his debut half hour is streaming on Season 1, Episode 2 of Comedy Central’s The Half Hour and on CBS on an upcoming episode of Comics Unleashed. Michael grew up in a small town in Indiana and began doing stand-up in Chicago after his parents moved the family to the suburbs during his formative years. Drew Hunt of The Chicago Reader writes about Michael’s stand-up, “In a lot of ways, he represents the ideal antidote to the sort of unbridled cynicism that pervades much of contemporary stand-up.” The Guardian writes, “In stand up, there is the writing, and then there is the performing. This guy nails both… clean, clever, dark and, most importantly, funny.” As a clean comedian, he has racked up multiple late night credits with appearances on The Tonight Show, The Late Show, The Late Late Show, and Conan. Additionally, he was a Top 5 Finalist on the last season of Last Comic Standing after eliminating Taylor Tomlinson in a head-to-head stand-up competition where one judge claimed, “My first impression of Michael was a great likability. This is a guy that could star in a sitcom.” Michael currently resides in California and is a dad. Every Monday night he records a podcast after his kid goes to sleep. It is called I Just Got My Kid To Sleep .

description:
Craig Robinson most notably portrayed acerbic Dunder-Mifflin employee Darryl Philbin on the Emmy-winning “The Office” on NBC. He is definitely a world away from his original career intentions; before deciding to pursue his comedy career full time, Robinson was a K-8 teacher in the Chicago Public School System. It was while he was studying education in Chicago that he also discovered his love of acting and comedy when he joined the famed Second City Theatre.

As a stand-up comedian, Robinson first made his mark in the comedy circuit at the 1998 Montreal Just For Laughs Festival. That year, he also won the Oakland Comedy Festival
Awards and the Miller Genuine Draft 1996 Comedy Search. He soon went on to perform his act on “The Jimmy Kimmel Show" and “Real Time with Bill Maher.” Now headlining venues and festivals across the country, he does both solo acts as well as full-band sets – “The Nasty Delicious” – tying together his lyrical comedy with his finesse at the piano. Whether Robinson shows up with just his keyboard or his seven-man band, the clubs are packed to the brim with raucous laughter and musical comedy.

description:
Tony Baker is a stand-up comedian, actor, and social media personality celebrated for his unique brand of humor and style. Raised in Chicago, Baker discovered his passion for performance during college, eventually transitioning from theater to stand-up comedy.

In addition to headlining  The Bald Brothers  tour — which sold out theaters worldwide and is now streaming as the comedy special  Bald Brothers: A Freestyle Comedy Show  on Tubi — Tony has become a fixture at the hottest comedy clubs around the country and earned a cult-like following from his debut stand-up special  Scaredy Cat .

In 2025, Tony earned a cameo opposite Keke Palmer and SZA in  One of Them Days . His other notable movie credits include  Haunted Heist ,  The Gutter , and  Outlaw Johnny Black . His television work includes  Marlon Wayans Presents The Headliners  on HBO,  The Carmichael Show , HBO’s  All DEF Comedy ,  Black Lady Sketch Show , TruTV’s  Laff Mobb’s Laff Tracks , and being a two-time finalist on NBC’s  Last Comic Standing  (Seasons 8 and 9). Tony can also be seen in  Churchy  on BET+,  Safe Space  on Tubi, and most recently, featured in  The Upshaws  on Netflix.

Baker’s engaging online presence earned him a nomination for Outstanding Social Media Personality at the 56th NAACP Image Awards in 2025. His legendary viral voiceover videos have made millions laugh worldwide, cementing his place as “your favorite comedian’s favorite comedian.” Known for signature “Bakerisms” and instantly quotable phrases like  “Skibbity Paps,” “Cram,”  and  “Look At Who Ya Came To See,”  Tony Baker continues to build a movement fueled by laughter, authenticity, and heart. So feel free to  “Get In On This”  and  “Feel Every Piece”  of the joy that Tony Baker brings to audiences everywhere.

description:
Sommore  reigns as the undisputed “Queen of Comedy.” This trendsetting, highly-acclaimed veteran entertainer is widely considered one of America’s top funny women. With a winning combination of class and sass, Sommore offers audiences a hilarious, yet piercing look at today's issues from a woman’s perspective. She is frank and fearless in her routines, tackling topics that range from the mundane to the controversial with wit, intelligence and style.

Praised by critics, respected by her peers, and adored by a diverse fan base, she performs her stand-up act to sold-out audiences across the country, and she is among the top-grossing stand-up comediennes in the United States and abroad. Oprah Winfrey proclaimed her “a force to be reckoned with in the new millennium.”

Born in Trenton, New Jersey, Sommore has had a meteoric rise to the top of her field and has been a trailblazer for women in the comedy business since her beginning in 1995. The comedian, actress, writer, executive producer, entrepreneur, and television host has created an undisputed name for herself as the “Queen of Comedy.”

Sommore is incredibly talented, hilarious and has made a mark in every genre of entertainment. The self-proclaimed "Chandelier" can be seen in films such as “Friday after Next", "Soul Plane", "Something New" and television series including the Academy Award-winning series “The Parkers” and "The Hughleys”.

She has been a featured guest on “The Oprah Winfrey Show,” “The Tonight Show with Jay Leno,” “The View” and “Politically Incorrect with Bill Maher.” She was also interviewed on CNN Headline News about her phenomenal artistic and financial success as a comedienne, and was profiled in Comedy Central’s “Special Women in Comedy” program.

Sommore has wrote, self produced, and performed in her own one woman Comedy Specials, “The Queen Stands Alone" (2008/Comedy Central), "Chandelier Status" (2013/Showtime), “The Reign Continues" (2015/Showtime), "A Queen with No Spades"…

description: Christopher Titus is a prolific stand-up comedian, writer, actor, and producer. As a creator, he has sold shows to NBC, ABC, FOX and Comedy Central. His wildly innovative multi-cam half hour Titus premiered to critical and audience acclaim on Fox, earning the show an Emmy nomination, while Titus himself received a WGA Award nomination for his writing. Following Titus, Christopher starred in ABC’s Big Shots, acting opposite Dylan McDermott, Michael Vartan and Josh Malina. He also starred in the NBC one-hour pilot, Future Tense and created and starred in the Bryan Cranston-directed pilot, Special Unit for Comedy Central. And he recently wrote, directed, and starred in a feature version of Special Unit which won the L.A. Film Award for Best Comedy Feature and the Hope Film Awards jury prize for Best Director. Christopher has written and starred in ten 90-minute comedy specials, with several spending months on the Billboard Top 10 comedy chart. His eighth special Amerigeddon is available on Amazon. He recently released his tenth special, Carrying Monsters, a bookend companion piece to Norman Rockwell is Bleeding (his very first show and the source material for the Fox series). His podcast, The Armageddon Update/Titus Podcast has over 10 million downloads. During the worst days of the pandemic, he used his self-owned studio as a safe space to exec produce and direct specials for Ron Funches, Fortune Feimster and Everlast. Christopher is currently touring his new show, Doomed to Repeat to sold-out audiences at clubs and theaters across the country. With a take-no-prisoners wit and years of experience writing hilariously edgy and poignant comedy, Christopher Titus is a voice unlike any other.
title: Christopher Titus: Doomed to Repeat

description:
Tony Baker is a stand-up comedian, actor, and social media personality celebrated for his unique brand of humor and style. Raised in Chicago, Baker discovered his passion for performance during college, eventually transitioning from theater to stand-up comedy.

In addition to headlining  The Bald Brothers  tour — which sold out theaters worldwide and is now streaming as the comedy special  Bald Brothers: A Freestyle Comedy Show  on Tubi — Tony has become a fixture at the hottest comedy clubs around the country and earned a cult-like following from his debut stand-up special  Scaredy Cat .

In 2025, Tony earned a cameo opposite Keke Palmer and SZA in  One of Them Days . His other notable movie credits include  Haunted Heist ,  The Gutter , and  Outlaw Johnny Black . His television work includes  Marlon Wayans Presents The Headliners  on HBO,  The Carmichael Show , HBO’s  All DEF Comedy ,  Black Lady Sketch Show , TruTV’s  Laff Mobb’s Laff Tracks , and being a two-time finalist on NBC’s  Last Comic Standing  (Seasons 8 and 9). Tony can also be seen in  Churchy  on BET+,  Safe Space  on Tubi, and most recently, featured in  The Upshaws  on Netflix.

Baker’s engaging online presence earned him a nomination for Outstanding Social Media Personality at the 56th NAACP Image Awards in 2025. His legendary viral voiceover videos have made millions laugh worldwide, cementing his place as “your favorite comedian’s favorite comedian.” Known for signature “Bakerisms” and instantly quotable phrases like  “Skibbity Paps,” “Cram,”  and  “Look At Who Ya Came To See,”  Tony Baker continues to build a movement fueled by laughter, authenticity, and heart. So feel free to  “Get In On This”  and  “Feel Every Piece”  of the joy that Tony Baker brings to audiences everywhere.

description:
Sommore  reigns as the undisputed “Queen of Comedy.” This trendsetting, highly-acclaimed veteran entertainer is widely considered one of America’s top funny women. With a winning combination of class and sass, Sommore offers audiences a hilarious, yet piercing look at today's issues from a woman’s perspective. She is frank and fearless in her routines, tackling topics that range from the mundane to the controversial with wit, intelligence and style.

Praised by critics, respected by her peers, and adored by a diverse fan base, she performs her stand-up act to sold-out audiences across the country, and she is among the top-grossing stand-up comediennes in the United States and abroad. Oprah Winfrey proclaimed her “a force to be reckoned with in the new millennium.”

Born in Trenton, New Jersey, Sommore has had a meteoric rise to the top of her field and has been a trailblazer for women in the comedy business since her beginning in 1995. The comedian, actress, writer, executive producer, entrepreneur, and television host has created an undisputed name for herself as the “Queen of Comedy.”

Sommore is incredibly talented, hilarious and has made a mark in every genre of entertainment. The self-proclaimed "Chandelier" can be seen in films such as “Friday after Next", "Soul Plane", "Something New" and television series including the Academy Award-winning series “The Parkers” and "The Hughleys”.

She has been a featured guest on “The Oprah Winfrey Show,” “The Tonight Show with Jay Leno,” “The View” and “Politically Incorrect with Bill Maher.” She was also interviewed on CNN Headline News about her phenomenal artistic and financial success as a comedienne, and was profiled in Comedy Central’s “Special Women in Comedy” program.

Sommore has wrote, self produced, and performed in her own one woman Comedy Specials, “The Queen Stands Alone" (2008/Comedy Central), "Chandelier Status" (2013/Showtime), “The Reign Continues" (2015/Showtime), "A Queen with No Spades"…

Known for his razor-sharp wit and rapid-fire punchlines, Russ has made audiences across the nation roar with laughter. His unique brand of humor has landed him appearances on prestigious platforms like Comedy Central, A&E Network, and Showtime.

Russ is not just your average comedian; he's also an avid biker, earning him the title of "America's Funniest Biker." His charismatic stage presence and hilarious anecdotes have captivated audiences worldwide, making him a sought-after headlining act on Princess, Celebrity, and Carnival Cruise Lines.

In addition to his live performances, Russ has showcased his comedic talents in a comedy special currently streaming on Prime Video titled "Uncle of Anarchy" solidifying his status as a comedic force to be reckoned with in the industry. With his southern charm and quick wit, Russ Nagel continues to leave audiences in stitches around the globe.

description: Christopher Titus is a prolific stand-up comedian, writer, actor, and producer. As a creator, he has sold shows to NBC, ABC, FOX and Comedy Central. His wildly innovative multi-cam half hour Titus premiered to critical and audience acclaim on Fox, earning the show an Emmy nomination, while Titus himself received a WGA Award nomination for his writing. Following Titus, Christopher starred in ABC’s Big Shots, acting opposite Dylan McDermott, Michael Vartan and Josh Malina. He also starred in the NBC one-hour pilot, Future Tense and created and starred in the Bryan Cranston-directed pilot, Special Unit for Comedy Central. And he recently wrote, directed, and starred in a feature version of Special Unit which won the L.A. Film Award for Best Comedy Feature and the Hope Film Awards jury prize for Best Director. Christopher has written and starred in ten 90-minute comedy specials, with several spending months on the Billboard Top 10 comedy chart. His eighth special Amerigeddon is available on Amazon. He recently released his tenth special, Carrying Monsters, a bookend companion piece to Norman Rockwell is Bleeding (his very first show and the source material for the Fox series). His podcast, The Armageddon Update/Titus Podcast has over 10 million downloads. During the worst days of the pandemic, he used his self-owned studio as a safe space to exec produce and direct specials for Ron Funches, Fortune Feimster and Everlast. Christopher is currently touring his new show, Doomed to Repeat to sold-out audiences at clubs and theaters across the country. With a take-no-prisoners wit and years of experience writing hilariously edgy and poignant comedy, Christopher Titus is a voice unlike any other.
title: Christopher Titus: Doomed to Repeat

description:
🛸 UFOs, Myths & Mysteries: Strange Chandler

A Walking Tour Through the Weird, the Wild, and the Unexplained

Chandler may look quiet under the desert sky, but history suggests we’re not always alone.

UFOs, Myths & Mysteries: Strange Chandler is a guided walking tour exploring the city’s strangest stories: unexplained lights, lost time, electromagnetic anomalies, Indigenous sky legends, and real incidents documented in police logs, maintenance records, and eyewitness accounts.

From the night of the 1997 Phoenix Lights , when clocks reportedly stopped downtown, to shimmering fountains, glowing alleyways, sky serpents, and modern light installations that may be repeating old signals, this tour blends documented events, desert science, folklore, and pop-culture mystery into one unforgettable experience.

This isn’t a haunted house, and it’s not a lecture.

It’s a playful, eerie journey through Chandler’s most curious moments, told with humor, history, and just enough “what if?” to keep you looking up.

You’ll walk the same streets where:

witnesses reported hovering craft and power surges

water rippled without wind

time seemed to skip

lights appeared, vanished, and sometimes came back

Whether you believe these stories are extraterrestrial, scientific, psychological, or something else entirely … Strange Chandler invites you to decide for yourself.

👣 Tour Details

📍 Start & End: Mic Drop Comedy, 51 E Boston St

🚶 Distance: ~½ mile loop

⏰ Duration: ~50 minutes

👟 Please wear comfortable walking shoes

👽 Recommended for teens & adults

Perfect for locals, visitors, skeptics, sci-fi fans, and anyone who enjoys history with a strange twist.

Some towns have ghost stories.

Chandler has sightings.

Come walk beneath the lights, and see what notices you back.

description:
Tony Baker is a stand-up comedian, actor, and social media personality celebrated for his unique brand of humor and style. Raised in Chicago, Baker discovered his passion for performance during college, eventually transitioning from theater to stand-up comedy.

In addition to headlining  The Bald Brothers  tour — which sold out theaters worldwide and is now streaming as the comedy special  Bald Brothers: A Freestyle Comedy Show  on Tubi — Tony has become a fixture at the hottest comedy clubs around the country and earned a cult-like following from his debut stand-up special  Scaredy Cat .

In 2025, Tony earned a cameo opposite Keke Palmer and SZA in  One of Them Days . His other notable movie credits include  Haunted Heist ,  The Gutter , and  Outlaw Johnny Black . His television work includes  Marlon Wayans Presents The Headliners  on HBO,  The Carmichael Show , HBO’s  All DEF Comedy ,  Black Lady Sketch Show , TruTV’s  Laff Mobb’s Laff Tracks , and being a two-time finalist on NBC’s  Last Comic Standing  (Seasons 8 and 9). Tony can also be seen in  Churchy  on BET+,  Safe Space  on Tubi, and most recently, featured in  The Upshaws  on Netflix.

Baker’s engaging online presence earned him a nomination for Outstanding Social Media Personality at the 56th NAACP Image Awards in 2025. His legendary viral voiceover videos have made millions laugh worldwide, cementing his place as “your favorite comedian’s favorite comedian.” Known for signature “Bakerisms” and instantly quotable phrases like  “Skibbity Paps,” “Cram,”  and  “Look At Who Ya Came To See,”  Tony Baker continues to build a movement fueled by laughter, authenticity, and heart. So feel free to  “Get In On This”  and  “Feel Every Piece”  of the joy that Tony Baker brings to audiences everywhere.

description:
Sommore  reigns as the undisputed “Queen of Comedy.” This trendsetting, highly-acclaimed veteran entertainer is widely considered one of America’s top funny women. With a winning combination of class and sass, Sommore offers audiences a hilarious, yet piercing look at today's issues from a woman’s perspective. She is frank and fearless in her routines, tackling topics that range from the mundane to the controversial with wit, intelligence and style.

Praised by critics, respected by her peers, and adored by a diverse fan base, she performs her stand-up act to sold-out audiences across the country, and she is among the top-grossing stand-up comediennes in the United States and abroad. Oprah Winfrey proclaimed her “a force to be reckoned with in the new millennium.”

Born in Trenton, New Jersey, Sommore has had a meteoric rise to the top of her field and has been a trailblazer for women in the comedy business since her beginning in 1995. The comedian, actress, writer, executive producer, entrepreneur, and television host has created an undisputed name for herself as the “Queen of Comedy.”

Sommore is incredibly talented, hilarious and has made a mark in every genre of entertainment. The self-proclaimed "Chandelier" can be seen in films such as “Friday after Next", "Soul Plane", "Something New" and television series including the Academy Award-winning series “The Parkers” and "The Hughleys”.

She has been a featured guest on “The Oprah Winfrey Show,” “The Tonight Show with Jay Leno,” “The View” and “Politically Incorrect with Bill Maher.” She was also interviewed on CNN Headline News about her phenomenal artistic and financial success as a comedienne, and was profiled in Comedy Central’s “Special Women in Comedy” program.

Sommore has wrote, self produced, and performed in her own one woman Comedy Specials, “The Queen Stands Alone" (2008/Comedy Central), "Chandelier Status" (2013/Showtime), “The Reign Continues" (2015/Showtime), "A Queen with No Spades"…

description: Christopher Titus is a prolific stand-up comedian, writer, actor, and producer. As a creator, he has sold shows to NBC, ABC, FOX and Comedy Central. His wildly innovative multi-cam half hour Titus premiered to critical and audience acclaim on Fox, earning the show an Emmy nomination, while Titus himself received a WGA Award nomination for his writing. Following Titus, Christopher starred in ABC’s Big Shots, acting opposite Dylan McDermott, Michael Vartan and Josh Malina. He also starred in the NBC one-hour pilot, Future Tense and created and starred in the Bryan Cranston-directed pilot, Special Unit for Comedy Central. And he recently wrote, directed, and starred in a feature version of Special Unit which won the L.A. Film Award for Best Comedy Feature and the Hope Film Awards jury prize for Best Director. Christopher has written and starred in ten 90-minute comedy specials, with several spending months on the Billboard Top 10 comedy chart. His eighth special Amerigeddon is available on Amazon. He recently released his tenth special, Carrying Monsters, a bookend companion piece to Norman Rockwell is Bleeding (his very first show and the source material for the Fox series). His podcast, The Armageddon Update/Titus Podcast has over 10 million downloads. During the worst days of the pandemic, he used his self-owned studio as a safe space to exec produce and direct specials for Ron Funches, Fortune Feimster and Everlast. Christopher is currently touring his new show, Doomed to Repeat to sold-out audiences at clubs and theaters across the country. With a take-no-prisoners wit and years of experience writing hilariously edgy and poignant comedy, Christopher Titus is a voice unlike any other.
title: Christopher Titus: Doomed to Repeat

description:
Tony Baker is a stand-up comedian, actor, and social media personality celebrated for his unique brand of humor and style. Raised in Chicago, Baker discovered his passion for performance during college, eventually transitioning from theater to stand-up comedy.

In addition to headlining  The Bald Brothers  tour — which sold out theaters worldwide and is now streaming as the comedy special  Bald Brothers: A Freestyle Comedy Show  on Tubi — Tony has become a fixture at the hottest comedy clubs around the country and earned a cult-like following from his debut stand-up special  Scaredy Cat .

In 2025, Tony earned a cameo opposite Keke Palmer and SZA in  One of Them Days . His other notable movie credits include  Haunted Heist ,  The Gutter , and  Outlaw Johnny Black . His television work includes  Marlon Wayans Presents The Headliners  on HBO,  The Carmichael Show , HBO’s  All DEF Comedy ,  Black Lady Sketch Show , TruTV’s  Laff Mobb’s Laff Tracks , and being a two-time finalist on NBC’s  Last Comic Standing  (Seasons 8 and 9). Tony can also be seen in  Churchy  on BET+,  Safe Space  on Tubi, and most recently, featured in  The Upshaws  on Netflix.

Baker’s engaging online presence earned him a nomination for Outstanding Social Media Personality at the 56th NAACP Image Awards in 2025. His legendary viral voiceover videos have made millions laugh worldwide, cementing his place as “your favorite comedian’s favorite comedian.” Known for signature “Bakerisms” and instantly quotable phrases like  “Skibbity Paps,” “Cram,”  and  “Look At Who Ya Came To See,”  Tony Baker continues to build a movement fueled by laughter, authenticity, and heart. So feel free to  “Get In On This”  and  “Feel Every Piece”  of the joy that Tony Baker brings to audiences everywhere.

description:
Sommore  reigns as the undisputed “Queen of Comedy.” This trendsetting, highly-acclaimed veteran entertainer is widely considered one of America’s top funny women. With a winning combination of class and sass, Sommore offers audiences a hilarious, yet piercing look at today's issues from a woman’s perspective. She is frank and fearless in her routines, tackling topics that range from the mundane to the controversial with wit, intelligence and style.

Praised by critics, respected by her peers, and adored by a diverse fan base, she performs her stand-up act to sold-out audiences across the country, and she is among the top-grossing stand-up comediennes in the United States and abroad. Oprah Winfrey proclaimed her “a force to be reckoned with in the new millennium.”

Born in Trenton, New Jersey, Sommore has had a meteoric rise to the top of her field and has been a trailblazer for women in the comedy business since her beginning in 1995. The comedian, actress, writer, executive producer, entrepreneur, and television host has created an undisputed name for herself as the “Queen of Comedy.”

Sommore is incredibly talented, hilarious and has made a mark in every genre of entertainment. The self-proclaimed "Chandelier" can be seen in films such as “Friday after Next", "Soul Plane", "Something New" and television series including the Academy Award-winning series “The Parkers” and "The Hughleys”.

She has been a featured guest on “The Oprah Winfrey Show,” “The Tonight Show with Jay Leno,” “The View” and “Politically Incorrect with Bill Maher.” She was also interviewed on CNN Headline News about her phenomenal artistic and financial success as a comedienne, and was profiled in Comedy Central’s “Special Women in Comedy” program.

Sommore has wrote, self produced, and performed in her own one woman Comedy Specials, “The Queen Stands Alone" (2008/Comedy Central), "Chandelier Status" (2013/Showtime), “The Reign Continues" (2015/Showtime), "A Queen with No Spades"…

Russ is not just your average comedian; he's also an avid biker, earning him the title of "America's Funniest Biker." His charismatic stage presence and hilarious anecdotes have captivated audiences worldwide, making him a sought-after headlining act on Princess, Celebrity, and Carnival Cruise Lines.

In addition to his live performances, Russ has showcased his comedic talents in a comedy special currently streaming on Prime Video titled "Uncle of Anarchy" solidifying his status as a comedic force to be reckoned with in the industry. With his southern charm and quick wit, Russ Nagel continues to leave audiences in stitches around the globe.

description:
👻  Whispers on Boston Street – Ghost Walk

History. Hauntings. Hometown Secrets.

Step beyond the charming storefronts and sunny sidewalks into the shadowy stories of Chandler’s past on this 75-minute guided walking ghost tour, starting and ending at Mic Drop Comedy Chandler (📍 51 E Boston St, Chandler, AZ 85225 ).

As the sun dips low and the streets grow quiet, you’ll follow your guide through historic downtown Chandler, where whispers of the past still echo between the bricks. We’ll journey through nearly a century of hidden history—from haunted hotels where the scent of cigar smoke hangs heavy in empty halls, to ghostly theaters where the reels still spin for no one. You’ll pass buildings where electricity first sparked to life—and may still flicker thanks to something unseen.

Hear tales of vanished cowboys, mysterious phone calls from empty rooms, unexplained cold spots, and the eerie scent of old medicine drifting through shuttered windows. These aren’t just ghost stories—they’re hometown legends, stitched into the bones of Chandler itself.

Whether you're a curious skeptic, a paranormal enthusiast, or just looking for a memorable night out, this immersive tour promises a walk through Chandler you’ll never forget—and may not want to walk alone.

description: Christopher Titus is a prolific stand-up comedian, writer, actor, and producer. As a creator, he has sold shows to NBC, ABC, FOX and Comedy Central. His wildly innovative multi-cam half hour Titus premiered to critical and audience acclaim on Fox, earning the show an Emmy nomination, while Titus himself received a WGA Award nomination for his writing. Following Titus, Christopher starred in ABC’s Big Shots, acting opposite Dylan McDermott, Michael Vartan and Josh Malina. He also starred in the NBC one-hour pilot, Future Tense and created and starred in the Bryan Cranston-directed pilot, Special Unit for Comedy Central. And he recently wrote, directed, and starred in a feature version of Special Unit which won the L.A. Film Award for Best Comedy Feature and the Hope Film Awards jury prize for Best Director. Christopher has written and starred in ten 90-minute comedy specials, with several spending months on the Billboard Top 10 comedy chart. His eighth special Amerigeddon is available on Amazon. He recently released his tenth special, Carrying Monsters, a bookend companion piece to Norman Rockwell is Bleeding (his very first show and the source material for the Fox series). His podcast, The Armageddon Update/Titus Podcast has over 10 million downloads. During the worst days of the pandemic, he used his self-owned studio as a safe space to exec produce and direct specials for Ron Funches, Fortune Feimster and Everlast. Christopher is currently touring his new show, Doomed to Repeat to sold-out audiences at clubs and theaters across the country. With a take-no-prisoners wit and years of experience writing hilariously edgy and poignant comedy, Christopher Titus is a voice unlike any other.
title: Christopher Titus: Doomed to Repeat

description:
Craig Robinson most notably portrayed acerbic Dunder-Mifflin employee Darryl Philbin on the Emmy-winning “The Office” on NBC. He is definitely a world away from his original career intentions; before deciding to pursue his comedy career full time, Robinson was a K-8 teacher in the Chicago Public School System. It was while he was studying education in Chicago that he also discovered his love of acting and comedy when he joined the famed Second City Theatre.

As a stand-up comedian, Robinson first made his mark in the comedy circuit at the 1998 Montreal Just For Laughs Festival. That year, he also won the Oakland Comedy Festival
Awards and the Miller Genuine Draft 1996 Comedy Search. He soon went on to perform his act on “The Jimmy Kimmel Show" and “Real Time with Bill Maher.” Now headlining venues and festivals across the country, he does both solo acts as well as full-band sets – “The Nasty Delicious” – tying together his lyrical comedy with his finesse at the piano. Whether Robinson shows up with just his keyboard or his seven-man band, the clubs are packed to the brim with raucous laughter and musical comedy.
